Entries.Title: Love All Play
Entries.Description: Badminton genius Tae-yang returns to the courts after 3 years, while Tae-joon decides to retire.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Badminton genius Tae-yang returns to the courts after 3 years, while Tae-joon decides to retire.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As Tae-joon joins team Yunis, Tae-yang asks him to become her partner as no one else wants to.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Tae-yang and Tae-joon become mixed doubles partners, and they're forced to play in a small tournament.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tae-joon changes his mind and heads to Wando. The Park twins are on a roll with a special strategy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Tae-yang decides to switch teams, disappointing Tae-joon. Tae-joon confesses his feelings to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Tae-yang returns to Yunis. The Park twins reaffirm their love and secretly start going out together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Tae-yang didn't congratulate Tae-joon on being chosen. They head to the sea, and Tae-joon hears a secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Tae-joon struggles to play after hearing Tae-yang's confession. He can't par up to Jung-hwan's skills.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Tae-joon leads Jung-hwan and the team to victory. Tae-joon also finds he is growing fonder of Tae-yang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Tae-yang is stuck in a slump, so she trains her body harder. Tae-joon keeps the secrets to himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Tae-yang decides to put her career on the line and confess, but Tae-joon reveals his secret to Tae-yang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Tae-yang thinks it is for the best that she leave for Tae-joon and the team. She decides to break up with Tae-joon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Things get awkward between Tae-yang and Tae-joon. Tae-yang hopes to remain friends, but Tae-joon gives her the cold shoulder.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Although they’ve broken up, Tae-yang worries over Tae-joon’s physical therapy. Meanwhile, a rumor that the two are still going out spreads.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Tae Joon offers to participate in the match together, which Tae Yang ponders over. She musters up the courage and agrees to be his partner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Taeyang wants to forfeit the final match of the tournament in order to save Taejun from further injuring his knee, but Taejun is determined to play.

Entries.Title: The Forbidden Marriage
Entries.Description: Yi Heon, the king of Joseon has ordered the Prohibition of Marriage as he has not yet found a queen. However, the prohibition is already in its seventh year. Heon is not able to choose a queen as he cannot forget his beloved Crown Princess who passed away years ago. But then, a girl who claims she can be possessed by the late Crown Princess appears before Heon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Yi Heon, the king of Joseon has ordered the Prohibition of Marriage as he has not yet found a queen. However, the prohibition is already in its seventh year. Heon is not able to choose a queen as he cannot forget his beloved Crown Princess who passed away years ago. But then, a girl who claims she can be possessed by the late Crown Princess appears before Heon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: So Rang officially starts working at the palace as a court lady. Her duty is to make sure Heon eats well, sleeps well, and help him talk to Ja Yeon. Although she is nervous that Heon might think of her as a fraud, she still does her best to make him lift the marriage prohibition. Also, So Rang's past is revealed. She tries to avoid everyone who once knew her as her true self, Ye Hyun Sun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Shin Won seems to realize that So Rang is Hyun Sun, but So Rang is not quite sure whether he knows or not. Meanwhile, Heon gets advice that it would be wise to go on a hunt. It is to show that Heon is still strong as always even without a queen. However, something unexpected happens at the hunting site and puts So Rang in need of a physician.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The absence of So Rang leaves Heon more bored than he expected. As she comes back after full recovery, she runs into a book writer at Aedaldang. Do Seok is a writer and painter who makes romance novels. With the masterpieces he made, So Rang tries to provoke Heon to wed a girl. Meanwhile, Lady Seo gets word that someone who resembles Hyun Sun is in town. She looks for her herself to get rid of loose ends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Even if it means defying the King, Shin Won cannot bear to see So Rang spend a night with Heon. Because of his feelings for her, the tension between Shin Won and Heon grows. Meanwhile, a rumor spreads across Hanyang that the ghost of the late Crown Princess is witnessed. Shin Won and So Rang are in search of the person who started such chaos.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The appearance of Ja Yeon's ghost stirs up the palace. However, Shin Won and So Rang investigate thoroughly to prove to Heon that she is not real. Eventually, they find out that someone has stolen the late Princess' court dress. The ghost is a person who just resembles Ja Yeon and is part of a scheme made by someone with a high rank within the palace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Heon and Shin Won quickly go after the kidnappers who took So Rang and Hae Young. Although they were able to find Hae Young, it seems So Rang has been taken somewhere else. Eventually, they find her well in a small village called Gongnyang Village. By seeing how the people here are living happily with loved ones, Heon realizes what he has been doing to the people of his country.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: So Rang believes that Heon still confuses her as the late Crown Princess. Although her love for Heon is sincere, she does not want it unless Heon feels the same way for her. Just as Heon is trying to prove that he also truly loves her, an attack on the Palace occurs. Chun Seok and Shin Won become severely hurt by the attack and leave Heon in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Shin Won leaves the palace and does not want to be found. Although Heon is sad to let his friend go, his relationship with So Rang becomes much deeper. However, Heon must now officially choose a queen and lift the Prohibition of Marriage. As So Rang does not want an official title, the two are not sure of what to do.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Heon finds out that So Rang is a fraud. Despite his love for her, he must banish her from the palace. However, assassins appear before her as soon as she gets banished and Shin Won is the only one who can save her. Meanwhile, the queen selection is currently the biggest issue in Joseon. Lady Seo does everything to make sure Hyun Hee gets selected.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Heon and So Rang reunite once again. During So Rang's absence, Heon realizes how much he desperately needs her in his life. Meanwhile, Shin Won captures the leader of the abduction ring. He interrogates the man and becomes one step closer to bringing Cho Sung Kyun down. As the end of the queen selection draws near, So Rang prepares to become who she is meant to be.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: So Rang finally steps up and retakes her rightful name. Hyun Ho also takes her side after realizing that he has been deceived by Lady Seo. The Prohibition of Marriage is lifted, and Joseon has become a country where everyone can love freely again. With So Rang as his Queen, Heon devotes himself to ruling Joseon by truly loving the people.

Entries.Title: The Golden Spoon
Entries.Description: Dirt spoon' Seung-cheon gets a hold of a mysterious golden spoon that can change his parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Dirt spoon' Seung-cheon gets a hold of a mysterious golden spoon that can change his parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon becomes Hwang Tae-yong with the spoon, but the real Tae-yong finds himself in trouble.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon learns that there is a rule about the golden spoon that the old woman did not tell him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon is worried that he might be found out, and a third person appears and puts him in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon decides to return to "Lee Seung-cheon" after hearing the news that Cheol might die.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Despite confirming his love with Ju-hee, Seung-cheon decides to return to Hwang Tae-yong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon discovers more secrets about the real Tae-yong while helping his poor family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon is shocked that Tae-yong may have killed President Na, and that he may take all the blame.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon returns to Korea ten years later and is reunited with Ju-hee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon agrees to be interviewed by Ju-hee, only because he wants to see her again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Ju-hee and Seung-cheon grow closer, and Tae-yong is getting closer to the secret of the golden spoon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Tae-yong meets the old woman. After learning everything, he decides to get his old life back.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon returns to his original self, and contemplates how to return to Hwang Tae-yong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Hyeon-do hides the fact that he also used a golden spoon and welcomes Seung-cheon as "Hwang Tae-yong".

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Through the death of Cheol, Seung-cheon regrets his past choices and makes a new resolution.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Seung-cheon, who has become a suspect in the murder, struggles to find a way to convict Hyeon-do.

Entries.Title: Military Prosecutor Doberman
Entries.Description: After being rejected from every law firm he applied to, Do Bae-man receives an offer he can't refuse. Cha Wu-in starts work at a new job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After being rejected from every law firm he applied to, Do Bae-man receives an offer he can't refuse. Cha Wu-in starts work at a new job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: A celebrity goes missing. No Tae-nam puts Bae-man's abilities to the test. Wu-in hands over key evidence to Han Se-na.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: No Hwa-yeong gets promoted. Bae-man assigns himself a final case before departing from active duty. Wu-in meets an old friend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Bae-man recovers a repressed memory. Tae-nam gets taken into custody. Yong Mun-gu gives him a way out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Wu-in proposes an alliance. Bae-man meets his first client as a big-firm lawyer. Tae-nam's case goes to court.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Tae-nam suffers the aftermath of the trial. Hwa-yeong gets Bae-man to prove his worth, while Wu-in questions his loyalty.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Wu-in drives a wedge between Hwa-yeong and Lee Jae-shik. Bae-man has a word with Ahn Su-ho. There is an attack at a book-signing event.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Wu-in reassesses Won Gi-chun's case. Bae-man goes after a medical officer. Kim Han-yong speaks out. Su-ho keeps his enemy close.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Mun-gu tells Hwa-yeong to watch out for Wu-in. Bae-man calls a press conference. Won Gi-chun threatens a witness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Bae-man and Wu-in get a hold of Gi-chun's journals and set their next target. A scandal shakes up Kang's Solution.

Episodes.Title: Epsiode 11
Episodes.Description: Bae-man and Wu-in learn of the secrets that were buried when their parents were killed. Abuse allegations are raised against Hong Mu-seop.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Sergeant Shin bares all about the treatment he's endured. Bae-man goes to court expecting a bumpy ride ahead. Tae-nam finds out that he's been played.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Mun-gu looks for Ha-jun's hard drive. Hwa-yeong rewrites the narrative of Mu-seop's case. Bae-man receives a tip about the secret society's X-files.

Episodes.Title: Epsiode 14
Episodes.Description: Hwa-yeong silences her son. Wu-in tries to get Pyeon Sang-ho to talk. Mun-gu secures a deal with the Department of Defense.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Tae-nam learns of the lengths his mother will go to protect herself. Wu-in tries to get Yang Jong-suk to turn. Hwa-yeong orders a hit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Mun-gu goes on the lam. Bae-man gets his hands on incriminating evidence. Hwa-yeong and the Patriotic Society face judgment.

Entries.Title: Why Her?
Entries.Description: Oh Soo Jae is a unique character at TK Law Firm and the wider legal professional community. She didn’t go to college, but she’s known for being a cut throat, star attorney. When her name comes up as one of the candidates to become TK’s next managing partner, everyone doubts that it will actually happen.

Episodes.Title: The New Managing Partner
Episodes.Description: Oh Soo Jae is a unique character at TK Law Firm and the wider legal professional community. She didn’t go to college, but she’s known for being a cut throat, star attorney. When her name comes up as one of the candidates to become TK’s next managing partner, everyone doubts that it will actually happen.

Episodes.Title: Professor Oh Soo Jae
Episodes.Description: Soo Jae is forced to take time off from working at TK Law Firm after rumours circulate that she drove Park So Young to suicide. She suddenly has to start working at Seojung University Law School as a professor. Meanwhile, Se Ryeon, one of Soo Jae’s students, puts up a poster on campus, detailing the misconduct of one of the Law School professors. She comes asking Soo Jae for help.

Episodes.Title: The Director Of The Legal Clinic Center
Episodes.Description: Soo Jae continues to face backlash over the suicide of Park So Young. With people attacking her left and right, only a handful of her students stand by her side. Soo Jae decides to give this case as a sort of assignment to her students. Meanwhile, Choi Ju Wan, the new managing partner of TK Law Firm and Chairman Choi Tae Guk’s son, gets himself into trouble.

Episodes.Title: The Park Ji Young Case
Episodes.Description: Director Baek tells Soo Jae to take on Park Ji Young’s case as the Legal Center’s first official case. Since Soo Jae and her students have already been working on this, they continue to search for evidence to prove that Ji Young is innocent. Meanwhile, Soo Jae senses danger lurking on her way home and calls Chan to let him know what is going on.

Episodes.Title: The One You Can Trust
Episodes.Description: Sensing that she’s in imminent danger, Soo Jae calls Gong Chan for help. Gong Chan arrives at her place and runs into a mysterious guy wearing a mask and gets into a scuffle. Later on, while Soo Jae tries to deal with the incident alone, she gets annoyed by Gong Chan’s constant care for her, but at the same time, she can’t deny that she feels somewhat protected.

Episodes.Title: Her Price Tag
Episodes.Description: Soo Jae offers an undeniable deal to trade what she has on Choi Tae Guk for seventy million dollars. Knowing that she has the upper hand, Tae Guk accepts the deal that heavily favours Soo Jae. While taking care of a little something for Tae Guk as a part of the deal, Soo Jae becomes overwhelmed by memories of her lost child. As it happened before, Soo Jae, in agony, looks for Gong Chan. That’s when she gets a call from someone she least expected.

Episodes.Title: Her Moment Of Crisis
Episodes.Description: Soo Jae shakes in fear when she realizes that she almost got killed in a car explosion involving Hong Seok Pal’s death. However, there is no one to whom she is willing to show her weak sides, except for maybe one person. Not long after, Soo Jae meets up with Tae Guk who suggests that she attend an event, but she rejects the offer without knowing what this will bring about in the near future.

Episodes.Title: Her Proof Of Innocence
Episodes.Description: Soo Jae gets arrested and locked up in a detention center after being accused of instigating Hong Seok Pal to murder Park So Young. Soo Jae lowers her stance on proving her innocence and carefully plans her way out of the situation. Meanwhile, Chan and Yoon Sang focus on getting their hands on anything that can prove that the evidence was fabricated. On the day of the warrant review, Soo Jae finds herself sitting in a courtroom alone until someone shows up.

Episodes.Title: Her Favourite Place
Episodes.Description: After the release, Soo Jae ends up living in Chan’s house with his roommates until her building’s renovation is finished. She feels at home with Chan by her side and finally finds a place where she can sleep after all these years. Meanwhile, knowing that Soo Jae could be a stumbling block, Choi Tae Guk realizes that something must be done and keeps his eyes on Soo Jae.

Episodes.Title: Her And His Past
Episodes.Description: A serious incident breaks out at Yeongpyeong District Construction Site, and everyone involved in Hansu Bio’s sell-off is summoned at once. While dealing with the collapse, a human skeleton is discovered, and Chan intuitively realizes that it has something to do with his sister’s death. Meanwhile, Soo Jae looks for Chan at his place, and she stumbles upon a little secret Chan has been hiding.

Episodes.Title: What Gong Chan Tried To Hide From Soo Jae
Episodes.Description: After finding out what Gong Chan has been hiding from Soo Jae all along, Soo Jae feels devastated and keeps a distance from him. She recollects her memories of how helpless she was when she defended Kim Dong Gu ten years ago. Meanwhile, Sung Bum pays a visit to the funeral of the victims of the construction site fall. He suddenly gets attacked by one of the bereaved family members and ends up being hospitalized.

Episodes.Title: His Reason To Go On
Episodes.Description: Yoon Sang organizes a meeting in the hopes of letting Chan know the unrevealed details of his case. However, the meeting doesn’t pan out as he anticipated. Chan demands an explanation from Yoon Sang about his actions. Yoon Sang shares his reasons while having Soo Jae listen to them over the phone. Chan doesn’t know Soo Jae is listening, but his care for Soo Jae is too touching for Soo Jae to handle.

Episodes.Title: Skeleton Identified
Episodes.Description: Director Baek holds a mock trial where students play the roles of judges, prosecutors, defendants, and witnesses before he resigns from university. Tae Guk is invited to the event and plays the role of the presiding judge without knowing that the case for the mock trial is very similar to the one of Na Jung’s death 10 years ago. Meanwhile, the skeleton in Yeongpyeong District gets identified. Will it be confirmed to belong to Na Jung?

Episodes.Title: Another Her
Episodes.Description: Soo Jae knew about Tae Guk’s way of handling things, but when she finds out what he did to her and her daughter, she breaks down. Soon after, she gathers herself together and prepares herself for what’s to come. Meanwhile, Soo Jae cannot get rid of the feeling of intimacy between Jae Yi and herself. On her way to meet Chan to share her new secret, she gets a call saying that Jae Yi has gone missing.

Episodes.Title: Disciplinary Hearing
Episodes.Description: After seeing her daughter die right before her eyes, Soo Jae falls into deep grief. She disappears with a letter left for Chan. Meanwhile, Tae Guk plans to disbar Soo Jae permanently. He tells the bar association to hold a disciplinary hearing and come up with every illegal action done by Soo Jae. With Jin Ki’s confirmation hearing right around the corner, he is accused of taking bribes in the past. Tae Guk promises that he will attend the hearing as a witness and defend Jin Ki.

Episodes.Title: This Is Her
Episodes.Description: At the disciplinary hearing, all parties claim their innocence, but no one seems to admit to their wrongdoings except for Soo Jae. On top of admitting to her wrongdoings, Soo Jae makes sure the world knows about Choi Tae Guk’s atrociousness and takes one step at a time to bring him to justice. In the battle of right against might, Soo Jae goes all in on what’s right.

Entries.Title: The First Responders
Entries.Description: On his first day, Detective Jin Ho-gae works jointly with firefighters to resolve a kidnapping case.

Episodes.Title: Code ZERO
Episodes.Description: On his first day, Detective Jin Ho-gae works jointly with firefighters to resolve a kidnapping case.

Episodes.Title: Code TWO
Episodes.Description: The first responders try to stop a suicide attempt, but the case turns out to be more complicated.

Episodes.Title: Code YELLOW
Episodes.Description: Ho-gae's house is said to be haunted. He and Do-jin try to solve the mystery that lies in the ashes.

Episodes.Title: Code V30
Episodes.Description: A driver is arrested after a hit-and-run accident of a child. A shocking truth awaits.

Episodes.Title: Code BLACK
Episodes.Description: Ho-gae starts an undercover operation. He must stop a crisis that may result in mass casualties.

Episodes.Title: Code RED
Episodes.Description: An unidentified body is found at the scene of a fire. An unlikely person is held as a suspect.

Episodes.Title: Code BLUE
Episodes.Description: Ho-gae identifies a new suspect, while the case becomes evermore ensnared in mystery.

Episodes.Title: Code CLEAR
Episodes.Description: Ho-gae reinvestigates a murder case and gets help from Song Seol and Yoon Hong.

Episodes.Title: Code PINK
Episodes.Description: Firefighters rush to save a teenage girl attempting suicide. Police find a body of a newborn baby.

Episodes.Title: Code AMBER
Episodes.Description: The first responders search for the father of the stillborn child. They then meet a strange patient.

Episodes.Title: Code ONE
Episodes.Description: Ho-gae misses Hyun-seo by a second. He and Seol pursue the evasive kidnapper.

Episodes.Title: Code F63.1
Episodes.Description: A series of fire incidents occur. Do-jin suspects a chain arson and goes to see Ho-gae.

Episodes.Title: Code ORANGE
Episodes.Description: A bound corpse emerges following a serial arson. The first responders to unite in the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Code B
Episodes.Description: Two fires break out in different locations. The first responders find themselves in a crisis.

Episodes.Title: Code R98
Episodes.Description: The first responders and the NFS cooperate to uncover clues to the serial arsonist.

Episodes.Title: Code GREY
Episodes.Description: The arsonist's final plan gets revealed. Can Ho-gae save everyone from danger and catch the criminal?

Episodes.Title: Rapport Building
Episodes.Description: When a murder occurs at Myeong-pil's villa, Ho-gae leaves his post and joins the case. Kang Do-ha joins the National Forensic Service.

Episodes.Title: Salami Tactics
Episodes.Description: Do-ha concludes that the death at the villa was an accident, but Ho-gae continues his investigation. Do-ha uncovers the dark side of the neighbours.

Episodes.Title: Hot Zone
Episodes.Description: An unidentified body is found after a brawl at a junkyard. A crisis arises during the autopsy.

Episodes.Title: Code GREEN
Episodes.Description: Criminals plan to endanger the NFS building. Can the team safeguard the place?

Episodes.Title: Code PURPLE
Episodes.Description: The police and fire department respond to an urgent call about a horrifying incident regarding organ extractions.

Episodes.Title: Trust Fall
Episodes.Description: Ho-gae delves into the investigation of Ma Joong-do's murder and reopens a past murder case and prison escape.

Episodes.Title: Overkill
Episodes.Description: Ho-gae vanishes after a caravan explosion. Amidst the chaos, a showdown is drawing near.

Episodes.Title: Dying Message
Episodes.Description: Supported by the NFS, the first responders confront the sinister mastermind in a decisive showdown.

Entries.Title: Little Women
Entries.Description: Oh In-joo turns to a work friend for help when an incident with her mother leaves her cash-strapped. Oh In-kyung digs into a four-year-old case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Oh In-joo turns to a work friend for help when an incident with her mother leaves her cash-strapped. Oh In-kyung digs into a four-year-old case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After discovering Jin Hwa-young’s surprising secret, In-joo comes to suspect a finance director to be the culprit of the murderous scheme.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: In-kyung causes a scene at a party celebrating Park Hyo-rin’s win in a contest. In-joo heads to a mental hospital to deliver an orchid and seek advice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In a secret garden, Won Sang-a commissions Oh In-hye to draw a portrait of her. In-joo and In-kyung debate over the fate of the found money.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: In-joo and In-kyung start new jobs and dig deeper into unanswered questions. Sang-a takes a sudden trip, inciting a surprising reaction.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: In-joo and In-hye debate what to do with a shocking piece of evidence. In-kyung contends with fallout from a media firestorm.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Reeling from recent events, the sisters must look further into the past in hopes of finding the truth. In-kyung unlocks a secret. In-joo hatches a plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: In-joo travels abroad and receives an unexpected welcome, leading to more questions. In-hye and Hyo-rin attempt to help Sang-a, who's in isolation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: In-joo is in grave danger following an encounter with a mysterious visitor abroad. In-kyung offers to make a deal to save her older sister.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Park Jae-sang faces a threat. With some help, In-hye and Hyo-rin set out to start fresh. In-kyung finds her own way of shining light on the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Jae-sang makes a drastic move. In the aftermath, the sisters face the wrath of familiar adversaries, newly emboldened with great power.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: During one sister's hearing, a bombshell courtroom appearance causes a stir. Emotions run high as lingering questions are finally answered.

Entries.Title: Shooting Stars
Entries.Description: Ace public relations executive Oh Han-byeol is thrust into emergency mode when her biggest — and most vexing — client returns with a scandal.

Episodes.Title: The Most Pointless Thing in the World
Episodes.Description: Ace public relations executive Oh Han-byeol is thrust into emergency mode when her biggest — and most vexing — client returns with a scandal.

Episodes.Title: The War of Shooting Stars
Episodes.Description: Gong Tae-seong becomes a bothersome presence to Han-byeol in the office. After a new employee makes a mistake, a story of Han-byeol’s past emerges.

Episodes.Title: Too Much Stress to Handle
Episodes.Description: A leaked photo creates a flutter. Park Ho-yeong approaches a potential but reluctant actor. Han-byeol and Tae-seong take stress questionnaires.

Episodes.Title: Shh! Do Not Upset Them!
Episodes.Description: At a fan event, an embarrassing moment for Han-byeol goes viral. When an eager Byeon Jeong-yeol takes his role too far, Tae-seong loses his cool.

Episodes.Title: Rumors. What You Want to Believe
Episodes.Description: Tae-seong tries to grab Han-byeol’s attention, but her work and StarForce’s charming attorney get in his way. An actor begins texting Cho Gi-ppeum.

Episodes.Title: Dramatic
Episodes.Description: Gi-ppeum and her ex scramble for an exclusive after missing a celebrity’s dating news. Tae-seong is irked by his new neighbor Do Su-hyeok.

Episodes.Title: If I Confess My Love...
Episodes.Description: After a hit role, Kang Si-deok’s celebrations take a messy turn. Tae-seong looks to confess his feelings to Han-byeol — but he’s not the only one.

Episodes.Title: Rules of Kissing
Episodes.Description: A figure from Tae-seong’s past returns to his life. Han-byeol is shaken by recent romantic revelations. An on-screen kissing scene raises tensions.

Episodes.Title: A Star’s Lover
Episodes.Description: Love is in the air for various celebs and StarForce reps, but the feeling isn’t always requited. Tae-seong’s housekeeper Kwon Myeong-hui is caught lying.

Episodes.Title: Scaling Mountains
Episodes.Description: A suspicious Kang Yu-seong looks into Myeong-hui’s background to determine her motives. Ho-yeong spills a long-held secret.

Episodes.Title: Warning! Do Not Fall for Good Looks
Episodes.Description: An “anti-fan” and a possible connection to the StarForce staff leaves Tae-seong weary. Myeong-hui tries to agitate Han-byeol.

Episodes.Title: Rumors of Rumors of a Rumor
Episodes.Description: False rumors spell trouble for Tae-seong’s reputation as his stresses mount and he struggles to come to terms with his mother’s presence.

Episodes.Title: Someone You Know
Episodes.Description: At a press conference, Eun Si-wu makes an emotional confession. Memories of a deceased close friend stir memories for Tae-seong and Han-byeol.

Episodes.Title: Back Then, if I...
Episodes.Description: A connection between foes targeting Tae-seong and Lee Yun-u’s death emerges. Yu-seong and Ho-yeong spend time together.

Episodes.Title: All About You
Episodes.Description: Hoping to stay close to Han-byeol while keeping their relationship secret, Tae-seong hatches a “method acting” plan, but gets on the PR team’s nerves.

Episodes.Title: All Sorts of People Who Clean Up Stars' Messes
Episodes.Description: A surprise wedding brings the StarForce family together, while Tae-seong plans a trip to be alone with Han-byeol, but not everything goes as planned.

Entries.Title: Thirty-Nine
Entries.Description: Cha Mi-jo announces her sabbatical to her two best friends. Chance encounters and sweet-scented peonies draw Kim Seon-u and Mi-jo together.

Episodes.Title: Thirty, Nine
Episodes.Description: Cha Mi-jo announces her sabbatical to her two best friends. Chance encounters and sweet-scented peonies draw Kim Seon-u and Mi-jo together.

Episodes.Title: One Absurd Day
Episodes.Description: Unable to let her go, Kim Jin-seok asks Jeong Chan-young to rethink their breakup. Mi-jo receives a heart-racing confession... and heartbreaking news.

Episodes.Title: Something I Had Never Thought Of
Episodes.Description: Jin-seok's wife confronts Chan-young. Lacking the courage to tell Chan-young the diagnosis, Mi-jo takes her anger out on someone else.

Episodes.Title: Choice
Episodes.Description: Chan-young and Jin-seok tearfully reveal their secrets to each other. A friend's sighting of Kim So-won at an unlikely place rattles Seon-u.

Episodes.Title: Rachmaninoff Piano Concerto No. 2
Episodes.Description: Chan-young creates a bucket list of her to-do items for loved ones. Mi-jo consoles a guilt-ridden Seon-u, who blames himself for So-won's sorrows.

Episodes.Title: Conviction
Episodes.Description: At an impromptu dinner for four, Seon-u's dad shows his affinity for Mi-jo and aversion for So-won. Chan-young's mom stops by while Jin-seok is over.

Episodes.Title: The Inconvenient Truth
Episodes.Description: Chan-young finds information on Mi-jo's birth mother and auditions to achieve a long-awaited dream. So-won moves into the orphanage.

Episodes.Title: When You Think It's the End
Episodes.Description: Seon-u asks his father to apologize to So-won. Chan-young's mom demands answers from the trio. Mi-jo learns of her biological mother.

Episodes.Title: A Thousand Nights Over and Over Again
Episodes.Description: Mi-jo's conversation with her birth mother leaves her distraught. Chan-young excitedly plans her mom's birthday, but nearly misses the celebration.

Episodes.Title: He Who Dances Must Pay the Piper
Episodes.Description: When a strange man comes looking for Mi-jo at her clinic, she seeks answers from her adoptive mother. Jang Joo-hee expresses her frustration and fear.

Episodes.Title: About Romance
Episodes.Description: Joo-hee and Mi-jo take Chan-young out to capture her smile after hearing she's taken her funeral photo. Mi-jo's parents invite Seon-u over for a meal.

Episodes.Title: Samseong-dong, Hyochang-dong and Gocheok-dong
Episodes.Description: Chan-young gets the chance to say goodbye to loved ones at an unforgettable brunch. Worried about Mi-jo, she leaves behind a surprise gift.

Entries.Title: May It Please the Court
Entries.Description: Noh Chak-hee, the ace lawyer of Jangsan, must keep her friend quiet in order to win her lawsuit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Noh Chak-hee, the ace lawyer of Jangsan, must keep her friend quiet in order to win her lawsuit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Chak-hee is suspended by Jang Gi-do and sent to a public defender's office in Jeongha.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A murder is discovered and Si-baek is named a suspect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After getting drunk, Chak-hee opens her eyes the next day to find herself in Si-baek's house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: An investigation into a serial murder case begins after the murder of a company president.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Chak-hee who is investigated by the police protects Si-baek's alibi, but her suspicions start to grow.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Chak-hee puts an end to her Jangsan's dog days and starts to change. She grows closer to Si-baek.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Si-baek, who accepts Gi-do's offer and conducts an interview, is arrested as a suspect in the murder.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Byeong-cheon is found dead and Duk-man, who confessed to the murder, commits suicide in prison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Si-baek confesses to the serial murders and calls Chak-hee as his lawyer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Chak-hee tracks down Si-baek's true identity and finds out the truth of Byeong-cheon and Gi-do's past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Chak-hee stands in a retrial of a thirty-year-old case to reveal the truth and correct her mistakes.

Entries.Title: Cheer Up
Entries.Description: The first year of Hae-yi’s Yonhee University life begins. On her first day, she runs into Jung-woo and hears about Theia. However, Theia is currently a squad that is about to go under due to a lack of members. Young-woong believes Hae-yi is the only person who can save the squad and tries to persuade her by offering what she needs most.

Episodes.Title: The Three Prophecies of Theia
Episodes.Description: The first year of Hae-yi’s Yonhee University life begins. On her first day, she runs into Jung-woo and hears about Theia. However, Theia is currently a squad that is about to go under due to a lack of members. Young-woong believes Hae-yi is the only person who can save the squad and tries to persuade her by offering what she needs most.

Episodes.Title: Joint Pep Rally
Episodes.Description: At the beginning of a new year, Yonhee and Hokyung compete in the joint pep rally. Whereas Hokyung has a powerful team, Theia lacks the minimum number of members. Therefore, Jung-woo decides to choose two freshmen to perform with the squad. Through a physical test, Hae-yi and Sun-ho get chosen. To prepare for the rally, the fiercest training awaits the two.

Episodes.Title: Hae-yi's Choice
Episodes.Description: The squad is busy getting ready for the joint pep rally. Jung-woo asks Hae-yi to overwork herself, and this leads the two on bad terms. Meanwhile, Sun-ho asks Hae-yi out once again, but she makes it clear this time that she is not interested. She hates Jung-woo for pushing her, but she feels something about him deep inside her heart.

Episodes.Title: Joint Pep Rally D-day
Episodes.Description: Hae-yi becomes sad for a bit to know that Jung-woo has a girlfriend. However, she then learns from Sun-ja that the two captains have already broken up months ago. With that in mind, Hae-yi steps up to the stage to perform the Joint Pep Rally. But she does not know what kind of trouble awaits her on stage.

Episodes.Title: Theia’s Field Trip
Episodes.Description: Although the joint pep rally is successful, Hae-yi could have been hurt badly if it wasn’t for Ha-jin and Sun-ho. Certain that this is not just an accident, Jung-woo digs in to find who is behind it. Theia goes on a field trip. The trip that should be filled with laughter and joy does not last that long. Someone is targeting Theia with bad intentions.

Episodes.Title: Yoo-min's Return
Episodes.Description: Yoo-min returns to the school saying that she has something left to do. Her sudden return is mysterious to everyone. Meanwhile, Theia is put in a tough spot as more than half of the freshmen quit after the release of the horrendous video. Hae-yi is also on the verge of quitting because of Min-jae’s proposal.

Episodes.Title: Misunderstanding
Episodes.Description: Jung-woo’s actions keep giving Hae-yi the wrong idea. But despite what he says, Jung-woo is also not sure what kind of emotions he has for Hae-yi. Meanwhile, Jae-yi gets into trouble at school. He beats up another kid and is about to get sued for it. However, Sun-ho promises to help him out for something in return.

Episodes.Title: Sun-ho's Weakness
Episodes.Description: Everyone has their own weakness, and so does Sun-ho. Although he is trying to find his own soft spot just to get Hae-yi’s attention, he actually realizes how hurt he is from it. Meanwhile, Jung-woo confronts Jae-min for what he did. He comes clean with the messages he sent but denies everything else. It turns out the sabotages are not done by a single person.

Episodes.Title: Glorious, Yonhee Festival
Episodes.Description: The day of the Yonhee Festival has come. The freshmen of Theia are extremely nervous as they will perform officially on stage. However, there are many things that Jung-woo must be concerned about. The freshmen performance might not take place due to a problem with the original singer, and the culprit who almost hurt Hae-yi might strike again.

Episodes.Title: Theia’s Field Trip
Episodes.Description: After the successful performance of Theia, the squad heads to Cheers to celebrate. However, everyone gets overwhelmed by excitement and drinks until they black out. As they wake up, they find themselves in Busan. Hae-yi cannot remember anything except having a kiss with someone. Devastated, she tries to find out who it is.

Episodes.Title: The Final Choice
Episodes.Description: The trip to Busan only makes it harder for Hae-yi to make her choice. Sun-ho kisses her and Jung-woo says he likes her. Although she tries to avoid the two guys ever since, the three groups up together for a dating assignment. After the date with each of them, she thinks deeply to find out who her heart truly desires.

Episodes.Title: Summer Training
Episodes.Description: Sun-ho is rejected by Hae-yi for the last time. Hae-yi and Jung-woo are now a couple but decide to keep it a secret from the others. Theia goes on a Summer Training camp. They go through passionate training and enjoy a pool party. However, an incident occurs that makes Sun-ja and Hae-yi drift away from each other.

Episodes.Title: Jin-il’s Reasons
Episodes.Description: Jin-il is the one who locked Hae-yi up and caused the fire. Thankfully, she makes it out in one piece. Jung-woo does not consider this an accident. He is certain that there is someone behind this. While Jung-woo and Cho-hee are trying to get to the bottom of this, Jin-il only makes the situation much worse.

Episodes.Title: Yonhee-Hokyung Rivalry
Episodes.Description: The Hokyung University Cheering Squad visits Yonhee to prepare for the rivalry. The SBC Broadcast Station also wishes to film them and air them on TV, making the two squads more competitive. Meanwhile, Sun-ho and Jung-woo set things clear about Hae-yi. Sun-ho decides to give up on her, but will remain as her good friend.

Episodes.Title: Hae-yi’s Tragedy
Episodes.Description: Despite the happiness that Hae-yi is having with Jung-woo, she asks him to break up with her. It is because Chun-yang is diagnosed with breast cancer. In order to earn money for surgery, Hae-yi must work more jobs and cannot make time for Jung-woo. However, Jung-woo does not give up on her and neither does her friends on the cheering squad.

Episodes.Title: The Future of Theia
Episodes.Description: Jung-woo finds Hae-yi in time and saves her from life-threatening danger. Although he gets hospitalized for getting stabbed, he is just happy that Hae-yi is safe. After Jung-woo’s recovery, Theia focuses back on preparing for the Yonhee-Hokyung Rivalry. Despite all the troubles and hardships everyone goes through, they will always have each other to rely on.

Entries.Title: Once Upon a Small Town
Entries.Description: Han Ji-yul’s stay in Huidong starts off on the wrong foot when he gets mistaken for a thief while trying to enter his grandfather’s home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Han Ji-yul’s stay in Huidong starts off on the wrong foot when he gets mistaken for a thief while trying to enter his grandfather’s home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The townsfolk meet Ji-yul with much enthusiasm and interest, including An Ja-yeong — who seems to be present wherever he goes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After a frustrating incident at the police station, Ji-yul coldly distances himself from Ja-yeong — a choice he will soon regret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ji-yul warms up to Ja-yeong and helps her care for a rescue dog. Meanwhile, the growing closeness between the two makes Lee Sang-hyeon uneasy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Sang-hyeon clears the air with Ja-yeong after the awkward encounter the night before. He then warns Ji-yul to back off.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Ja-yeong attends a town meeting and gets caught in the cross hairs of an ongoing feud. Ji-yul looks for a solution to an old man’s heartbreaking request.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Ji-yul tiptoes around Ja-yeong, not knowing how to break the ice after the shocking revelation. Meanwhile, a heartbroken boy comes to him for advice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After getting a chance to hang out and unwind on a spontaneous work trip, Ji-yul and Ja-yeong come home to find unexpected visitors from Seoul.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Ja-yeong drifts further away from Ji-yul after her new housemate asks for her help to win back an ex-boyfriend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Ji-yul finds that he's running out of time as he grows more certain of his feelings for Ja-yeoung. Sang-hyeon gets his long-awaited response.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Ji-yul gives Ja-yeong a tour of his clinic in Seoul as they continue to sneak around town on secret dates.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: When work delays the much-anticipated night out with Ji-yul, Ja-yeong plucks up the courage to make a special announcement to the entire neighborhood.

Entries.Title: Again My Life
Entries.Description: Hee Woo is a prosecutor known for his rather crazy methods. He starts investigating Cho Tae Sub, a man who wields the utmost power in the running of the country. During the investigation, Hee Woo realizes that he has died. However, the woman he meets after his death gives him a second chance at life and revenge.

Episodes.Title: Hee Woo’s Death
Episodes.Description: Hee Woo is a prosecutor known for his rather crazy methods. He starts investigating Cho Tae Sub, a man who wields the utmost power in the running of the country. During the investigation, Hee Woo realizes that he has died. However, the woman he meets after his death gives him a second chance at life and revenge.

Episodes.Title: Back To Being A Student
Episodes.Description: Hee Woo goes back to living as a 21-year-old. He realizes that he can actually change the course of his life and does his best to live life to its fullest. Meanwhile, he keeps remembering events from his past life that he thought was unfortunate and changes their outcomes. Later on, Hee Woo goes back to being a law student.

Episodes.Title: The Master Of Auctions
Episodes.Description: Hee Woo settles into his life as a college student once more and gets started on his revenge against Cho Tae Sub in earnest. He seeks out teachers to help him get ready for the long-term fight that lies ahead. In the process of doing so, Hee Woo meets an elderly gentleman, known as the master of auctions.

Episodes.Title: The Telecommunications Race
Episodes.Description: Hee Woo continues to keep a close eye on Cho Tae Sub’s actions. One day, Min Soo introduces Hee Woo to a friend of his who has a brilliant idea. Sung Hwan is a former med school student who has now developed an idea for a smartphone application. Knowing that this will benefit Cho Tae Sub if he doesn’t step in, Hee Woo decides to help Sung Hwan.

Episodes.Title: Seven Years Later
Episodes.Description: Hee Woo helps change the life of Sang Man and his dad before he goes off to serve in the military once again. Seven years go by, and Hee Woo returns as a prosecutor. However, he volunteers for a position at a small country branch office instead of Seoul. As he starts to look into local crimes, the name of a gang continues to grab his attention.

Episodes.Title: The Ticket To Seoul
Episodes.Description: Hee Woo’s quest to get to the bottom of corruption and crime in Gimsan continues. He finally reveals to Seok Kyu that he intends to take everyone at the Gimsan Branch Office to Seoul with the success of this case. Meanwhile, Hee Woo reconnects with his friends from college as they all play a role in Hee Woo’s grand scheme.

Episodes.Title: Getting Closer To Cho Tae Sub
Episodes.Description: After successfully shutting down the case in Gimsan, Hee Woo returns to the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office. As Hee Woo gets closer to Cho Tae Sub and his inner circle, Il Hyun begins to show his true colors. Meanwhile, a medical student becomes the leading suspect in a murder case, but Hee Woo suspects something is amiss.

Episodes.Title: The Real Culprit
Episodes.Description: The med student Lee Ju Seok desperately pleads his innocence, but Jang Il Hyun has no intention of listening. However, as Hee Woo steps in and proves Ju Seok’s claim, everything goes down for Il Hyun. His loss destroys everything that the higher-ups are trying to cover up for CEO Jeon Il Bo. For the prosecution, Il Hyun is now nothing but a tail to cut loose.

Episodes.Title: Taking Down the Enemy One by One
Episodes.Description: Hee Woo’s plan to take down Il Hyun pans out as a success when he is arrested on bribery charges. However, Hee Woo continues to work with his friends, Kyu Ri and Min Soo, to go after Kang Jin as well. Meanwhile, Hee A keeps refusing to accept Gun Young’s suggestion that she must be the successor of Chunha Group. Then, Hee Woo becomes acquainted with Assemblyman Hwang Jin Yong.

Episodes.Title: The List of Corruption
Episodes.Description: Assemblyman Hwang Jin Yong reveals the names on the list to the public. With almost a hundred politicians being on that list, the corrupted fall into panic. However, Cho Tae Sub sees this as an opportunity. He increases his power by bringing in all the dirty politicians under his control in exchange for redemption. As the list did not hit as hard as Hee Woo thought it would, he does not stop here.

Episodes.Title: The Death Of Chairman Kim Gun Young
Episodes.Description: Chairman Kim Gun Young tries his best to hold off Cho Tae Sub’s greedy advances for Chunha Group and names Hee A his successor. However, Cho Tae Sub decides to take Chairman Kim out of the equation for good. Meanwhile, Hee Woo reacts to Cho Tae Sub’s advances by offering Hee A his help, but Hee A is wary of his intentions.

Episodes.Title: Going After Kim Seok Hoon
Episodes.Description: As Hee Woo’s plans to take down Chief Prosecutor Kim Seok Hoon continue, he finds himself in a precarious position between the chief prosecutor and Assemblyman Cho Tae Sub. In order to find the dirt on Kim Seok Hoon, Hee Woo and his friends dig into Bando Bank’s corruption and JQ Constructions.

Episodes.Title: Kim Seok Hoon’s Confirmation Hearing
