Meanwhile, due to the many circumstances surrounding the two, Jiyeon and Jae-hoon grow closer.

Episodes.Title: Unwelcomed Guest
Episodes.Description: Jae-hoon picks up Yeo-reum, who is all alone in the abandoned house, but adds that he only was ever worried as a friend. Yeo-reum, bitter with how their relationship now getting awkward, finds solace in Hye-jin and Dae-sik as she tells them of her situation. Meanwhile, Love Kingdom is in tatters due to an unwelcomed guest.

Episodes.Title: Truth Behind the Camera
Episodes.Description: Due to the incident within the set, Love Kingdom is now cancelled. Chae-ri attempts to find ways to revive the show, as new love is found after the news has spread within the cast. As Jae-hoon and Ji-yeon grow closer, Yeo-reum grows uneasy. The two meet in an empty house after dark.

Episodes.Title: The Final Choice
Episodes.Description: Jae-hoon and Yeo-reum reaffirm their interest in one another. The two set plans to talk again when Love Kingdom terminates. Meanwhile, the cast of Love Kingdom go on their final dates before their ultimate choice, resulting in a hectic climax. On the day of the final choice where the cast decides their partner, a drunk So-yeon is found on the balcony.

Episodes.Title: You May Go Home
Episodes.Description: In an attempt to save a cast member from an accident, Yeo-reum is injured and is escorted to the hospital, with Jae-hoon by her side. With the production of Love Kingdom wrapped up, Chae-ri looks on as the dust is settled. Another rumour pops up, a rumour of adultery between a production staff and a cast member.

Episodes.Title: After the Reality Show
Episodes.Description: After appearing in Kingdom of Love, Jae-hoon becomes famous. Whether he wants it or not, he's in the center of rumors and gossip. On top of that, an article says Yeo-reum and Jae-hoon are living under the same roof. As the rumor spreads, they become careful. Meanwhile, Jae-hoon contemplates after receiving a call from Professor Choi asking if he'd return to neurosurgery.

Episodes.Title: Never Ending
Episodes.Description: Jae-hoon decides to go back to the hospital and Yeo-reum decides to quit her job. The day the last episode of Kingdom of Love Season 2 airs, everyone sits around with their own stories. Afterwards, they ask off-color questions to each other. Yeo-reum and Jae-hoon sit down in the garden as usual. Jae-hoon gazes at her with warmth in his eyes, and she tells him she wants to leave for a while.

Entries.Title: Behind Every Star
Entries.Description: Kim Jung-don faces a predicament when a big Hollywood director refuses to cast Cho Yeo-jeong because of her age. So Hyun-joo asks Ma Tae-oh for a job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Kim Jung-don faces a predicament when a big Hollywood director refuses to cast Cho Yeo-jeong because of her age. So Hyun-joo asks Ma Tae-oh for a job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Shaken by the recent tragedy, Lee Hee-jun decides to back away from a role until a rival actor steps in to replace him. Hyun-joo makes a friend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Two actresses, who are very close and are in-laws in real life, get cast in the same show. But they soon develop second thoughts about working together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Soo-hyun faces countless obstacles after landing her first action role since becoming a mom. Meanwhile, Chun Jane makes a move on Lee Sang-uk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The constant bickering between two stars causes major delays in production. Hyun-joo tries to save an actor from getting killed off on a show.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jane mediates between an actor and a director who keep fighting during rehearsal. Her job starts to take a toll on her relationship with Sang-uk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: A married celebrity couple has their relationship tested when a photo of the wife with another man surfaces online. Jane meets a childhood friend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Method Entertainment falls under new management with a boss who's not afraid of shaking things up. Jane tries to recruit an actor from a rivaling firm.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: While preparing to star in a new show, Kim Joo-ryoung realizes she’s developed a new phobia. The tension between Jane and Koo Hae-jun gets out of hand.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jane tries to get Daniel Henney to work with a director who has held a four-year grudge against him. Kang Hee-sun auditions for a movie musical.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: An actor's frequent memory lapses raise questions about whether he can continue working in a film production. Hyun-joo has a turbulent time at work.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Jane ponders the true meaning of her job when she faces a major threat to securing the perfect dress for an actress ahead of a red carpet event.

Entries.Title: Through the Darkness
Entries.Description: Song Ha-yeong pursues a criminal known for targeting young women. Kook Yeong-su looks to form a team of criminal behavioral analysts.

Episodes.Title: Red Cap Incident
Episodes.Description: Song Ha-yeong pursues a criminal known for targeting young women. Kook Yeong-su looks to form a team of criminal behavioral analysts.

Episodes.Title: Habits of Criminals
Episodes.Description: Ha-yeong consults a criminal to understand a killer’s motives. An arrest leads to a startling interrogation session and a break in the case.

Episodes.Title: Ha-yeong Meets Tae-gu Again
Episodes.Description: The grisly murder of a child catches the attention of Ha-yeong and Yeong-su. A determined police captain clashes with the team.

Episodes.Title: What Must We Remember?
Episodes.Description: When a suspect’s home is searched, the police make a gruesome discovery. Ha-yeong and Yeong-su grow frustrated as the investigation continues.

Episodes.Title: Looking into the Minds of Evil
Episodes.Description: A crooked new police chief causes trouble for the team. The deaths of a professor and his wife touch off a series of brutal murders.

Episodes.Title: The Man With the Hiking Boots
Episodes.Description: Yoon Tae-gu and Kim Bong-sik seek to set boundaries on the behavioral analysis team. A complex investigation sends the police down a twisted path.

Episodes.Title: A Scary Wolf Inside the Rabbit Burrow
Episodes.Description: Ha-yeong spends time with his mother on his birthday. With two killers on the loose, the investigators are faced with high-pressure stakes.

Episodes.Title: There Are No Perfect Crimes
Episodes.Description: A chase takes a risky turn. When a suspect asks for a high-ranking officer, Ha-yeong hatches a plan. A search for victims' bodies continues.

Episodes.Title: Becoming the Monster
Episodes.Description: The behavioral analysis team agrees to an interview with a journalist. Ha-yeong seeks to enter the killer’s mind, but it takes a toll on him.

Episodes.Title: I Just Liked It
Episodes.Description: During interviews and crime scene reenactments, Ha-yeong and the police dive deep into a ruthless suspect's psyche and past trauma.

Episodes.Title: The Victims And Their Families
Episodes.Description: A horrific accident forces Ha-yeong to reflect on the mental impact of his work. Meanwhile, two people go missing from a karaoke bar, raising suspicions.

Episodes.Title: The Hearts of Criminals
Episodes.Description: Police and the analysis team investigate a murder suspect who is known for charming women and luring them into his car.

Entries.Title: It's Beautiful Now
Entries.Description: Kyung Chul is the head of the Lee Family and lives with his son, daughter-in-law, and two of his three grandsons. Hyun Jae, the second grandson, is a talented divorce lawyer. Hyun Jae goes to meet a very special client on behalf of his boss, Hae Jun. Meanwhile, Kyung Ae goes to a wedding and gets upset when her friends point out that none of her sons are married yet.

Episodes.Title: The Lee Brothers
Episodes.Description: Kyung Chul is the head of the Lee Family and lives with his son, daughter-in-law, and two of his three grandsons. Hyun Jae, the second grandson, is a talented divorce lawyer. Hyun Jae goes to meet a very special client on behalf of his boss, Hae Jun. Meanwhile, Kyung Ae goes to a wedding and gets upset when her friends point out that none of her sons are married yet.

Episodes.Title: The Marriage Project Begins
Episodes.Description: Mi Rae desperately wants Hyun Jae to take her on as a client and convinces him to do so. She goes around collecting evidence, even meeting with Jun Hyung. Meanwhile, Kyung Ae gets Min Ho and Kyung Chul together to come up with a plan to get her boys married. They decide to make the boys' competitive nature come out by putting up a tempting prize.

Episodes.Title: Joining The Race
Episodes.Description: The three brothers find themselves being offered an apartment unit for the Marriage Project. Soo Jae is excited to take part in it, but Yoon Jae and Hyun Jae are just baffled by it all. They wonder if they should actually agree to participate in this race. Meanwhile, Mi Rae continues to struggle with cutting ties with Jun Hyung.

Episodes.Title: Yu Na Changes Her Mind
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jae and Mi Rae find out about the assault charge that Jun Hyung filed. Mi Rae is scared that Jun Hyung might cause more trouble in her life. Meanwhile, Yu Na goes to take her exam with Soo Jae's enthusiastic support. However, when things don't go as she planned, she reconsiders Soo Jae's offer.

Episodes.Title: Soo Jae Brings Yu Na Home
Episodes.Description: Soo Jae's family gets caught off guard when he brings Yu Na home as someone he will marry. However, he casually introduces her to them, and the family's elders become fond of her. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae's mind keeps thinking about the divorce case his ex-girlfriend So Young Eun brought to him that he refused to take on.

Episodes.Title: Hyun Jae’s TV Appearance
Episodes.Description: Mi Rae does her best to help Hyun Jae with his sudden TV appearance. Hyun Jae thanks her for her support and takes her home, making Mi Rae's parents question their relationship. Meanwhile, Soo Jae's friend asks him about signing a contract for the gym, and Yoon Jae's plans for starring on the dating show don't go as he expected.

Episodes.Title: Young Eun Re-enters Hyun Jae’s Life
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jae feels uncomfortable with Young Eun reentering his life. Mi Rae also feels awkward between the two former lovers. Meanwhile, Hae Jun contemplates what to do about her feelings for Yoon Jae after he gets drunk and passes out on her couch. Soo Jung works hard to persuade Jung Ja to let her bring her mother to live with them.

Episodes.Title: Mi Rae Starts Her Own Business
Episodes.Description: Soo Jung is upset that Mi Young refuses to come to live with her. Meanwhile, Mi Rae opens up her new office. Despite the happy occasion, she feels bothered by Young Eun as she keeps lingering around Hyun Jae. While Soo Jae and Yu Na continue to sense weird feelings between themselves, Yoon Jae finds himself wanting to see and talk to Hae Jun more and more.

Episodes.Title: Mi Rae Confesses Her Feelings
Episodes.Description: Mi Rae regrets showing Hyun Jae her feelings for him. Hyun Jae also feels confused as to how he should react. Meanwhile, Soo Jae and Yu Na's relationship also gets more complicated when he asks her for a kiss. Yu Na also feels guiltier about lying to Soo Jae's family since they're so nice to her. Also, Hae Jun gets upset that Yoon Jae hasn't called her.

Episodes.Title: Hyun Jae Rejects Mi Rae
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jae politely rejects Mi Rae's confession that she likes him. Mi Rae feels sad, despite the fact that she understands where he's coming from. Meanwhile, Soo Jae gets ready to actually marry Yu Na at his mom's insistence. He gathers his brothers to ask for their support, but it only seems to make Yoon Jae and Hyun Jae more competitive.

Episodes.Title: Soo Jae And Yu Na Begin A New Relationship
Episodes.Description: Mi Rae frantically tries to find her client who has disappeared. Hyun Jae tries to calm her down and helps her out. Meanwhile, Soo Jae and Yu Na confirm their feelings for one another. Although they feel elated about their new relationship, they also feel somewhat confused as to where they are headed in terms of their business deal.

Episodes.Title: Hae Jun And Yoon Jae Start Casually Dating
Episodes.Description: Hae Jun goes to meet Yoon Jae, expecting to hear that he likes her. However, all she gets is a lukewarm response, leaving the two in an awkward pre-dating phase. Meanwhile, Kyung Ae goes to talk to Hyun Jae at his office about the marriage project and runs into Hae Jun in the elevator. Later on, Hyun Jae finally realizes what his feelings are for Mi Rae.

Episodes.Title: Hyun Jae Confesses His Feelings For Mi Rae
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jae finally figures out his feelings for Mi Rae and confesses to her. Mi Rae is rather surprised by his sudden confession but not in a bad way. Meanwhile, Soo Jae feels threatened by Yoon Jae's declaration that he has been seeing someone. With the race for the apartment still on, Soo Jae tries to speed things up with his marriage plans.

Episodes.Title: Mi Rae Feels Disappointed By Hyun Jae
Episodes.Description: Mi Rae feels disappointed when Hyun Jae cancels their plans at the last minute. Hyun Jae feels sorry but goes to attend an urgent meeting with a client, then heads over to see his family. Meanwhile, Kyung Chul keeps the car accident a secret from Min Ho and returns home. Yoon Jae and Hae Jun go on a date on their day off.

Episodes.Title: Hyun Jae Gives Mi Rae Driving Lessons
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jae teaches Mi Rae how to drive, but Mi Rae keeps noticing the incoming phone calls from the screenwriter she saw Hyun Jae with at his office. They still enjoy going on dates and spending time together. Meanwhile, Min Ho feels a mix of emotions when he sees Kyung Chul getting teary while talking about his hidden feelings.

Episodes.Title: Yu Na’s Guilt Continues To Grow
Episodes.Description: Mi Rae feels utterly happy about her relationship with Hyun Jae, but Soo Jung worries that Mi Rae might be hurt. She advises Mi Rae to pace herself in terms of her emotions. Meanwhile, Soo Jae is somewhat bothered by Yu Na's boss, Jung Hoo. Later on, Kyung Ae takes Yu Na to try on wedding dresses, making Yu Na feel guiltier than ever.

Episodes.Title: Yu Na Has An Outburst
Episodes.Description: Kyung Ae is surprised by Yu Na's sudden outburst but soon consoles her. Kyung Ae also tells Soo Jae to ease Yu Na's mind about getting married. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae contemplates what he can do to make Mi Rae feel more assured about their relationship. Yoon Jae wonders why he feels like there's a shift in Hae Jun's attitude.

Episodes.Title: Yoon Jae Gets Nervous
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jae finishes his song for Mi Rae and runs into Yu Jin. He introduces Mi Rae as his girlfriend and the two officially say hello. Meanwhile, Yoon Jae feels nervous about Hae Jun's attitude towards him, especially after she tells him that her interest in him is now gone. Soo Jae and Yu Na go on dates all across Seoul to taste different kinds of bread at famous bakeries.

Episodes.Title: Yoon Jae And Hae Jun Start Officially Dating
Episodes.Description: Yoon Jae and Hae Jun become an official couple after they share a kiss, but Hae Jun worries that Yoon Jae will find out about the lie she told Ms. Sun about him. Meanwhile, Soo Jae gets nervous about both Hyun Jae and Yoon Jae entering into relationships. He rushes to seal the deal on taking over the gym.

Episodes.Title: So Ra Figures Out Who Yoon Jae Is Dating
Episodes.Description: Min Ho and his family go to pay their respects at his birth parents' graves. Once they return home, they enjoy a family meal with Kyung Chul and Kyung Soon. Meanwhile, So Ra hears that the woman Yoon Jae is seeing is a patient around Yoon Jae's age. She figures out the identity of this woman, although Yoon Jae tries to deny it.

Episodes.Title: Soo Jae Gets A Strange Feeling
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jae suddenly comes knocking at the door, sending Hae Jun and Yoon Jae into a frenzy to hide the evidence that Yoon Jae was there. Hae Jun pretends to be nonchalant as she lets him into the house. Meanwhile, Soo Jae gets a strange feeling when the gym that he took over isn't open. He calls his friend Chang Yeol, but he doesn't answer.

Episodes.Title: Secret Relationships Revealed
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jae is surprised to find out that Yoon Jae and Hae Jun have been dating, and Hae Jun also feels betrayed by Hyun Jae and Mi Rae deceiving all this time. Meanwhile, Yu Na finds it strange when Soo Jae keeps avoiding her calls. She decides to get him a present for his new gym and finds out what he has been hiding from her.

Episodes.Title: The Double Date
Episodes.Description: Yoon Jae hurts his back carrying Hae Jun. Hae Jun feels slightly responsible and treats him the best she can. Meanwhile, Mi Rae nurses Hyun Jae throughout the night at his house. However, Soo Jung notices that Mi Rae still hasn't returned home from work and begins to worry about her.

Episodes.Title: Yu Na Confesses
Episodes.Description: Yu Na can't contain the guilt inside her anymore and tells Kyung Ae the truth. Kyung Ae becomes furious at her betrayal and tells her she doesn't want to see her anymore. Kyung Ae frantically gets a hold of Soo Jae, tells him what she knows, and screams at him to come home. However, Soo Jae doesn't and ignores her calls.

Episodes.Title: Soo Jae’s Repentance
Episodes.Description: Yu Na won't accept Soo Jae's words of breaking up and grabs him from behind. Meanwhile, Soo Jung meets with Hyun Jae but talks to him sternly, showing little amiability toward him and upsetting Mi Rae. Later, Yoon Jae and Hyun Jae try to give Soo Jae the brotherly talk, but in the end, Soo Jae walks out on them.

Episodes.Title: Soo Jae Worries His Family Again
Episodes.Description: Soo Jae suddenly gets detained by police officers and ends up at the police station. Min Ho receives the call about what happened. Soo Jae gets an earful and feels sorry for worrying his family again. However, he knows for sure he wants to be with Yu Na and gives her a call.

Episodes.Title: Yu Na Ends It With Soo Jae
Episodes.Description: Yu Na makes up her mind and ends things with Soo Jae. Soo Jae can't stop her from walking away but asks her one last time to reconsider. Meanwhile, Hae Jun proposes marriage to Yoon Jae, but he can't give her an answer. Later, an unhappy client shows up at the law firm to see Hae Jun.

Episodes.Title: Soo Jung Worries About Her Mother
Episodes.Description: Mi Young falls out of bed and gets taken to a bigger hospital. Soo Jung receives the call from the doctor and rushes frantically to see her. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae suggests to his father that he should meet Mi Rae for the first time. Later, Yoon Jae formally proposes marriage to Hae Jun and introduces her to the family.

Episodes.Title: A Daughter’s Past
Episodes.Description: After hearing what Mi Young said, Jin Ju becomes suspicious of Soo Jung's background. She also becomes jealous and spiteful toward Soo Jung when Jung Ja tells her she'd leave the building she owns to Soo Jung. Meanwhile, Kyung Ae gets shocked and displeased when she sees Hae Jun at her house.

Episodes.Title: Jin Ju Confronts Soo Jung
Episodes.Description: Kyung Ae meets Mi Rae, but she feels strangely nervous and knocks over a glass of water by accident. Meanwhile, Hae Jun becomes upset at her brother and his wife after meeting them with Yoon Jae, thinking they don't highly support her plans for marriage. However, it's an eye-opener for Yoon Jae.

Episodes.Title: Soo Jung Confesses
Episodes.Description: Jung Ja can't believe Soo Jung's secret past and almost faints at her confession. Soo Jung leaves the house to stay with her mother at the hospital. Meanwhile, Yoon Jae and Hae Jun march straight ahead with their wedding plans. However, Kyung Ae begins to show her disapproval of their marriage.

Episodes.Title: The Family Meeting
Episodes.Description: Yoon Jae's shirt explodes as he enters the room with everyone watching, but he manages to pull through the family meeting with the help of his brothers. Hae Jun's brother and her brother's wife say things that don't sit well with Kyung Ae. It bothers her a lot, and she gets into an argument with Yoon Jae. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae meets Jin Heon for the first time while visiting Mi Young at the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Mi Young’s State Becomes Worse
Episodes.Description: Mi Young loses consciousness with pneumonia and gets rushed to the intensive care unit. Soo Jung is devastated and doesn't know what to do. Meanwhile, Hae Jun receives a call from a hotel regarding a vacancy for a wedding reservation. Hae Jun and Yoon Jae rush to prepare for their wedding.

Episodes.Title: Mi Young Passes Away
Episodes.Description: Mi Young takes her last breath and leaves Soo Jung weeping in agony. Hyun Jae gets Mi Rae's call while enjoying Hae Jun's get-together dinner and rushes out to see her. Meanwhile, the superstition of receiving bad luck from attending a wedding after a funeral keeps Hae Jun from showing her condolences and has others worried about attending Hae Jun and Yoon Jae's upcoming wedding.

Episodes.Title: The Big, Juicy Peach
Episodes.Description: Yoon Jae and Hae Jun successfully wrap up their wedding and head off to a hotel to enjoy the night together. Hyun Jae and Mi Rae catch up on dating and have a wonderful time together. Meanwhile, Kyung Ae comes home from the wedding and has a conception dream in her short nap.

Episodes.Title: A DNA Match
Episodes.Description: After thinking long and hard about looking for her birth parents, Soo Jung registers her DNA in the missing persons' database and returns home. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae and Mi Rae get ready to tell their families about their engagement and set a date for the family meeting. Later, Soo Jung gets a call from the missing persons' support center with a DNA match.

Episodes.Title: Soo Jung Rejects Kyung Chul
Episodes.Description: Kyung Chul realizes that Soo Jung is his long-lost daughter, Jung Eun. However, Soo Jung rejects him and leaves him without saying much. Later, Min Ho meets with Soo Jung privately to see if he could change her mind about his father. Meanwhile, Hyun Jae and Mi Rae prepare for their wedding and dream of a happy marriage.

Episodes.Title: Fates Entwined
Episodes.Description: After learning that Kyung Chul is Soo Jung's biological father, Jung Ja and Kyung Soon adamantly oppose Hyun Jae and Mi Rae's marriage. The elders tell Hyun Jae and Mi Rae to postpone their wedding without giving them a reason. Hyun Jae and Mi Rae find it suspicious and become anxious.

Episodes.Title: Hyun Jae And Mi Rae Take A Time Out
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jae gets upset at Mi Rae's words and agrees to stay apart for the time being. However, he expresses to her that he is against breaking up. Meanwhile, Kyung Chul tells Soo Jung about her past while he asks for her forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: Min Ho’s Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Kyung Chul becomes extremely upset at Min Ho after hearing him say he would remove himself from the family register for Hyun Jae's sake. However, Min Ho still thinks it's the only way for everyone to be happy. Meanwhile, Soo Jung develops suspicions about how she came to be the daughter of her late parents.

Episodes.Title: Hyun Jae’s Resolve
Episodes.Description: Mi Rae tells Hyun Jae they should end things, but Hyun Jae refuses to let go. He determines to do everything he can to make their wedding come true. Meanwhile, Soo Jung reads the letters Kyung Chul had written to her on her past birthdays one by one.

Episodes.Title: Kyung Chul’s Blessing
Episodes.Description: Now that things have worked out between Soo Jung, Kyung Chul gives Hyun Jae and Mi Rae his blessing on their wedding. Hyun Jae and Mi Rae are stunned and ecstatic at his words. Meanwhile, Jung Ja is a little upset that nothing was discussed with her before Kyung Chul gave them the go-ahead.

Episodes.Title: Hyun Jae And Mi Rae Get Married
Episodes.Description: After having their small wedding reception, Hyun Jae and Mi Rae's families see them off as they leave for their honeymoon. Soo Jae and Jung Hoo get left by themselves to drink and get through the awkwardness. Meanwhile, Yu Na visits her mother and learns her younger brother is in serious trouble.

Episodes.Title: An Allergic Reaction
Episodes.Description: Yoon Jae apologizes to Hyun Jae for spitting water in his face and calms the situation down. Meanwhile, Hae Jun and Mi Rae shower Kyung Ae with gifts and money to win her heart. Later, Soo Jung and Jin Heon have dinner at Kyung Chul's house, but Soo Jung has an allergic reaction.

Episodes.Title: Competing For Love
Episodes.Description: Kyung Ae goes to Yoon Jae and Hae Jun's house and lets her frustration out. Soo Jae takes good care of Yu Na after she hurts her leg to save him. Meanwhile, Hae Jun and Mi Rae compete to win Kyung Ae's love with a hidden secret they can't wait to share.

Episodes.Title: Morning Sickness For Yoon Jae
Episodes.Description: The family is ecstatic to learn that both Mi Rae and Hae Jun are pregnant, and they celebrate together. However, for some reason, Yoon Jae keeps running to the toilet with morning sickness. Meanwhile, Kyung Ae sees Yu Na and Jung Hoo together grocery shopping and worries about Soo Jae.

Episodes.Title: Saving Soo Jung
Episodes.Description: After learning that Soo Jung has liver cancer, Jin Heon falls into shock. However, Soo Jung tells him they should keep it a secret from Hyun Jae and Mi Rae for the time being. Meanwhile, Kyung Ae begins to feel sorry for Yu Na but also worries she might start seeing Soo Jae again.

Episodes.Title: A Home Cooked Meal
Episodes.Description: Mi Rae finds out Soo Jung has cancer and drops to the floor. She is devastated that she can't help her mother. Hyun Jae learns about Soo Jung and offers to get tested for donor compatibility. Meanwhile, Soo Jung invites Kyung Chul, Min Ho, and Kyung Ae for a homecooked meal despite the distressing mood.

Episodes.Title: Kyung Chul Faints
Episodes.Description: Kyung Chul faints and gets rushed to the hospital. Soo Jung is shocked at the news and urgently goes to the hospital to see him. Meanwhile, Kyung Ae is upset at Hyun Jae for getting the compatibility test done without discussing it with her first. Although he explains that this is what he wants, the idea doesn't sit well with everyone.

Episodes.Title: Out Of Time
Episodes.Description: Soo Jung's health deteriorates, and she gets admitted to the hospital. Everyone worries for her well-being, especially Hyun Jae, who is determined to convince Kyung Ae and Soo Jung to accept his decision to be the liver donor. Fortunately, Kyung Ae has a change of heart, and she decides to talk with Soo Jung.

Entries.Title: Love in Contract
Entries.Description: Choi Sang-eun gives customized marriage contracts for singles needing a marriage. After 13 years in the business, she wants to retire but finds it hard to end it with Jung Ji-ho, a long-term customer of Mon, Wed, and Fri. They’ve been together for 5 years, but she knows nothing about him and delays ending their contract. Meanwhile, superstar Kang Hae-jin moves in the top floor of Ji-ho’s house...

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Choi Sang-eun gives customized marriage contracts for singles needing a marriage. After 13 years in the business, she wants to retire but finds it hard to end it with Jung Ji-ho, a long-term customer of Mon, Wed, and Fri. They’ve been together for 5 years, but she knows nothing about him and delays ending their contract. Meanwhile, superstar Kang Hae-jin moves in the top floor of Ji-ho’s house...

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun's hurt by Ji-ho asking to end the contract first. She delays it giving a flimsy excuse. She's strangely upset with him and is confused by it. Meanwhile, Hae-jin sees his first love Sang-eun who disappeared 13 years ago after leaving a strong impression but is shocked she is Ji-ho’s wife. To make the matters worse, he witnesses Ji-ho’s strangeness and believes that she is in danger...

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun, Ji-ho and Hae-jin have a three-way encounter at the mansion. Ji-ho reveals his identity to Hae-jin due to his suspicion. Sang-eun gets to know Ji-ho a little bit more but despite what she wants the time for to end the contract comes. When the contract ends, restless Sang-eun visits Ji-ho with divorce papers as an excuse to see him but is attacked by a mysterious armed-man...

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun's surprised at Ji-ho giving her concert tickets, not divorce papers. They extend their contract as they run into his senior judge and his wife. Madam Yoo is in big trouble after seeking a comeback after losing everything 13 years ago due to Sang-eun. Sang-eun saves her and give up her retirement despite her love-hate relationship. Meanwhile, Hae-jin gets into trouble from a false rumor...

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun is angry at Hae-jin. Hae-jin asks Sang-eun to take him as her customer. She is torn seeing him vulnerable and eventually, she accepts his offer. Ji-ho feels uncomfortable about their contract. Sang-eun tries to clear up the misunderstanding but is not easy. Meanwhile, Madam Yoo is released from the detention center and stays at Sang-eun, and their uncomfortable living situation begins...

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun needs to settle a contract with Hae-jin. After some quarreling, Ji-ho's day is Mon, Wed, and Fri and Hae-jin on Tues, Thur, and Sat. And the alternate day marriage begins. Meanwhile, Sang-eun and Ji-ho prepare a housewarming party for his work. While decorating the house they develop feelings. At the housewarming party, Sang-eun drinks too much and gets a serious blackout the next day...

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun remembers her first kiss with Ji-ho but is upset as Ji-ho seems indifferent. They hide their feelings causing their relationship to be awkward. As Hae-jin uses work as excuse and goes on a date with Sang-eun, he’s feelings towards Sang-eun grows even more. Meanwhile, Madam Yoo visits Ina group and threatens to take back Sang-eun into their family again…

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ji-ho tries to find a way to express his feelings toward Sang-eun. During a couple’s golf gathering, he doesn’t hold back to show kindness and care towards Sang-eun causing her to have mixed feelings about him. Meanwhile, Hae-jin happily waits for Tues, Thurs and Sat but gets into a big fight with Ran-hee who questions about Sang-eun. He then collapses in front of Sang-eun due to extreme stress.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun meets Ji-eun, ex-wife of Ji-ho and a legal advisor of Hae-jin. Ji-ho says no more than there’s nothing between them but Sang-eun’s thoughts gets tangled. After filming, Hae-jin misses Sang-eun and visits her but drunk Ji-ho appears and three of them have an awkward gathering at the beach. When Ji-ho witnesses Hae-jin and Sang-eun being close, he appears to be bothered for the first time…

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Ji-ho and Sang-eun realized their feelings for each other and he surprises his co-workers by coming to work very differently than usual. Sang-eun tries to end the contract with Hae-jin to focus her relationship with Ji-ho and Hae-jin tries to give up his feelings for her but finds it difficult. Meanwhile, Ji-eun finds out Sang-eun had contracts with both Hae-jin and Ji-ho and visits Ji-ho’s house…

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun worries about Ji-ho as she is exposed to the public. Ji-ho’s senior informs about his promotion but doesn’t tell Sang-eun. Sang-eun tells Gangjin group’s family she doesn’t want to marry Hae-jin. Ji-ho makes questions for Sang-eun and they have a great time. While Hae-jin’s at the police station due to his clash with Sang-eun’s stalker. Sang-eun’s in shock when the stalker is revealed…

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun’s 12th marriage is unveiled causing controversy and she insists she’s at fault to protect Hae-jin. She asks Ji-ho to have some space due to this. Ji-ho and Hae-jin is upset seeing Sang-eun trying to bear everything. Ji-ho hears from Gwang-nam of Madam Yoo’s provocation to Sang-eun and investigates her and Ina group. Hae-jin prepares a conference to squelch criticism towards Sang-eun…

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun rushes to the hospital in shock when she hears of a mysterious car accident. Ji-ho comforts her and they become closer. Hae-jin makes a formal announcement of his breakup with Sang-eun. Chairman Gangjin tells him to join Gangjin group. Seon-jin feels threatened and uses Sang-eun to ingratiate himself with his father. Meanwhile, Ji-ho questions the car accident and starts investigating…

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun looks for what she wants to do after her retirement and Ji-ho supports her. Hae-jin enters the Gangjin group where he shines causing a conflict with Seon-jin. Sang-eun visits Hae-jin as she’s worried about his sudden retirement but Hae-jin purposely acts distant towards her. Meanwhile, Sang-eun finds out that Ji-ho met Ji-eun to grant her a wish causing them to have a lover’s quarrel…

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: While Sang-eun and Ji-ho have a lovely time dreaming of their future together, people ordered by Seon-jin secretly break into Sang-eun’s house. Hae-jin learns of this and tells Madam Yoo of Seon-jin’s scheme to use Project Jamie. Madam Yoo decides to take all the blame to protect Sang-eun and Ji-ho goes against his principle for the first time to stop her…

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: After that day, Ji-ho waits for Sang-eun who didn’t turn up. Sang-eun doesn’t have the courage and hesitates and Ji-ho returns to his cold self. The co-workers become more worried seeing Ji-ho being so emotionless. Meanwhile, Sang-eun realizes her feelings through honest advice from Gwang-nam and Madam Yoo…

Entries.Title: Eve
Entries.Description: A new year starts for Liyan Kindergarten, the global leader in the field of early education. Parents from prestigious backgrounds gather for a fundraiser at Liyan. Kang Youn-kyum, the representative of LY Group, also attends with his wife for her daughter. However, there he meets a young woman who sparks something in his heart. A spark that can endanger everything he built until now.

Episodes.Title: Liyan’s New Beginning
Episodes.Description: A new year starts for Liyan Kindergarten, the global leader in the field of early education. Parents from prestigious backgrounds gather for a fundraiser at Liyan. Kang Youn-kyum, the representative of LY Group, also attends with his wife for her daughter. However, there he meets a young woman who sparks something in his heart. A spark that can endanger everything he built until now.

Episodes.Title: Ra-el's Secret Identity
Episodes.Description: Eun-pyeong climbs higher in politics. Despite his success and popularity, he still remembers everything about Ra-el and her real mother even after all these years. Knowing in his gut that Ra-el is still alive, he continues the search. Meanwhile, Youn-kyum feels his heart burning when he thinks of Sun-bin. Although his emotion is about to burst, he has no intention of fighting it.

Episodes.Title: Night at Sewoonjung
Episodes.Description: While satisfying Dam-ri and Ji-hee, Sun-bin approaches So-ra at the same time. With her charms and wit, she manages to obtain So-ra’s trust. Sun-bin and Jin-wook get invited to Sewoonjung, Youn-kyum’s personal party where not anyone can join. By using this big step, Sun-bin moves forward with her plan of vengeance for her true identity, Ra-el.

Episodes.Title: The Truth of Kang Youn-kyum
Episodes.Description: Sun-bin is on a clear path to gaining So-ra’s total trust. With the trust she gains, she must investigate the ledgers of LY Group that might be in Youn-kyum’s study. However, Eun-pyeong finds shocking information about Kang Youn-kyum. Something that Ra-el has no clue about and something that can ruin her plan of taking down LY Group.

Episodes.Title: Love and Lust
Episodes.Description: Youn-kyum does not fall for Ra-el easily. Just when things seem to be in a tight spot, Ra-el comes up with a plan by using So-ra’s birthday. Meanwhile, although Eun-pyeong is well-known for not taking any politician or conglomerate’s side, he is willing to do whatever he can to help Ra-el achieve her goal. Step by step, she becomes closer to punishing all those who destroyed her family.

Episodes.Title: The Evil Witch
Episodes.Description: So-ra is enraged with Youn-kyum’s disappearance. Despite the presence of her daughter, she does not control her emotions. Meanwhile, Youn-kyum confesses his true feelings to Ra-el. With true love as his source of energy, he determines to break free from being LY’s puppet. Ra-el’s revenge begins to speed up. The day of vengeance is soon to come.

Episodes.Title: Ra-el Gets Close to Youn-kyum
Episodes.Description: Now that Ra-el knows about her mother Jin-sook's death, she seeks revenge by getting close to Youn-kyum. Ra-el sees his scars. She knows it isn't right, but she can't resist and slowly falls for Youn-kyum. Eun-pyeong teams up with Pan-ro to help Ra-el. Meanwhile, So-ra's compulsive behavior goes out of control when she suspects Youn-kyum is seeing another woman.

Episodes.Title: Ra-el Disappears
Episodes.Description: So-ra uses the hit-and-run accident to her advantage and begins to search for Youn-kyum's mistress. Ra-el keeps her distance, hitting Youn-kyum and So-ra mentally. And as soon as she disappears, Youn-kyum yearns for her even more. Meanwhile, So-ra kidnaps Ra-el's bodyguard to find Youn-kyum's woman, and a fierce battle of nerves begins between So-ra and Ra-el. Later, Ra-el makes her return dressed lavishly.

Episodes.Title: Ra-el Becomes Anxious
Episodes.Description: Youn-kyum and So-ra don't react as Ra-el expected. So-ra starts to ostracize Ra-el at the kindergarten now that she knows Ra-el is Youn-kyum's mistress. Ra-el starts to become anxious, seeing no difference in Youn-kyum and So-ra's relationship. Meanwhile, Eun-pyeong takes the president's chief secretary position and vows to help Ra-el get her revenge as his love for her grows deeper.

Episodes.Title: Ra-el’s Impatience
Episodes.Description: Ra-el falls deeper into the darkness after Moon-hee's betrayal and Youn-kyum's indifference. To get Youn-kyum to move, Ra-el deals with him coldly, grabbing and letting go of his heart. Later, at LY Shopping Mall's formal gathering, So-ra falls into Ra-el's plot.

Episodes.Title: Youn-kyum Demands Divorce
Episodes.Description: Youn-kyum goes to the house of roses after he tells So-ra he wants a divorce. His love deepens while enjoying his time there. He tells Ra-el he loves her. She tries to turn a blind eye to his endearment, but she can't help herself and falls deeper into love. Meanwhile, Eun-pyeong warns Ra-el that it could get dangerous if she stays with Youn-kyum.

Episodes.Title: Ra-el Comes Out Of Hiding
Episodes.Description: Ra-el sees Youn-kyum's sincerity and gets torn by her love for him and her revenge. Meanwhile, news about Youn-kyum's private life begins to circulate that enrages So-ra. So-ra orders one of her men to capture Ra-el at all costs. Eun-pyeong saves her but sustains a critical injury. And because of it, Ra-el determines to face So-ra head-on and take what's hers.

Episodes.Title: A Drop Of Doubt
Episodes.Description: So-ra gives Youn-kyum clues about Ra-el's identity. Ra-el and Youn-kyum's relationship becomes compromised with So-ra's drop of doubt. Realizing there isn't much time left, Ra-el thinks only of her revenge. Youn-kyum senses Ra-el's secret, but it doesn't cloud his love for her. And Ra-el has a hard time taming her heart for his unconditional love.

Episodes.Title: Ra-el Take Charge
Episodes.Description: Youn-kyum is utterly shocked when he learns about Ra-el's secrets. Ra-el and Eun-pyeong believe Pan-ro has Moon-hee. Eun-pyeong storms Pan-ro's residence with the police to search for Moon-hee, but they come up empty-handed. Ra-el learns more about her mother's death and becomes further enraged. Ra-el takes the lead in Moon-hee's place to finish her revenge, and Eun-pyeong helps her in any way he can.

Episodes.Title: Love for One’s Enemy
Episodes.Description: The trial proceeds as scheduled, and Youn-kyum himself shows up in the courtroom. At the same time, with the evidence left behind by Moon-hee, Ra-el turns So-ra and Pan-ro against each other. Cornered and pressured, So-ra finds herself turning into the weakest version of herself. Meanwhile, Youn-kyum asks for forgiveness, even if it means sacrificing his own life.

Episodes.Title: The True Love
Episodes.Description: Jung-chul heads to the villa where Ra-el and Youn-kyum are. He is determined to hurt Ra-el as much as she had hurt him. Youn-kyum ends up killing Jung-chul, and he decides to turn himself in. Ra-el receives the gift Youn-kyum left him, and she decides to leave for Buenos Aires upon seeing it. Sometime later, Eun-pyeong decides to go and see Ra-el in Buenos Aires.

Entries.Title: The Law Cafe
Entries.Description: Yu Ri, a pro bono lawyer, decides to open a law café where she can give friendly advice to those seeking legal advice. She believes the best lawyer is someone who solves the problems even before they proceed to court. She meets the landlord of the new café, and it turns out to be her old friend, Kim Jung Ho, a former prosecutor.

Episodes.Title: Meeting An Old Friend
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri, a pro bono lawyer, decides to open a law café where she can give friendly advice to those seeking legal advice. She believes the best lawyer is someone who solves the problems even before they proceed to court. She meets the landlord of the new café, and it turns out to be her old friend, Kim Jung Ho, a former prosecutor.

Episodes.Title: Loving One Woman For 17 Years
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri decides to abide by the rules Jung Ho has set and moves into his building. Despite what they agreed upon, Jung Ho keeps meddling in Yu Ri’s business out of concern. Yu Ri gets the first client who is seeking advice on the noise problem from the upper apartment unit. Soon, it turns out to be a bigger problem than just a noise issue.

Episodes.Title: Fan-cident
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri decides to hold an information session for the residents of Pureun Apartments. But after hearing that the compensation won’t be much, most of them decide to give up on the lawsuit. However, a few of them come back to Yu Ri later to fight against Dohan Construction. Jung Ho ends up helping Yu Ri and the residents reluctantly.

Episodes.Title: In The Name Of Family
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri finds Nurungi killed in the café, and Jung Ho comes to rescue her. The police start looking into the case, but they can’t find the culprit. A new client asks Yu Ri how she can deal with a guy who lives next door who’s been stalking her. Later, the stalker shows up at the café and tells a surprising story.

Episodes.Title: Thoughts On The Legitimacy Of A Kiss
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri explains why she kissed Jung Ho and tells him that she likes him. Jung Ho is flustered by how easily she confesses her feelings but also quite bitter, thinking her feelings may not be as deep as his. A new client comes to the café and inquires about revoking the suspension of her indictment.

Episodes.Title: Unfathomable
Episodes.Description: The president of Dohan Constructions, Lee Pyun Woong, visits Yu Ri, asking to scout her. Jung Ho warns him again never to mess with her. A client comes to the Law Café, asking for details about juvenile law. Eun Gang senses that something’s off with him, so he follows him out.

Episodes.Title: Sin And Punishment
Episodes.Description: Eun-gang, Jung-ho, and Yu-ri decide to tell the truth about the arson case to the police. Instead of framing the bullies, Jung-ho reports them to the school violence control committee and corrects their wrongdoing. However, one of the bullies takes things too far and ends up kidnapping Jung-ho.

Episodes.Title: There Are Islands Between People
Episodes.Description: After kissing Yu Ri, Jung Ho keeps avoiding her, thinking he made a mistake. Woo Jin and the members of the Law Café go to Jungpyeong Island where they provide free medical services and legal counselling. Yu Ri and Jung Ho meet two ladies who have had a dispute for quite a while, so they provide a solution for them.

Episodes.Title: Lies, Lies, Lies
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri is summoned by Korean Bar Association for breaking the Attorney-at-law Act, but Jung Ho comes in to help. Jung Ho’s father, Chief Prosecutor Kim Seung Woon, gets questioned about his involvement with Dohan Group. Meanwhile, the ladies of Happy Mart come to Yu Ri to ask for her help on a fraud case.

Episodes.Title: Brilliant Legacy
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri gets hospitalized after a car hits her. Jung Ho warns Pyung Woong not to mess with her again. Yu Ri learns from her mother that her late father wouldn’t want her to live in resentment for the rest of her life. So she decides to forgive Jung Ho. Meanwhile, Jung Ho’s mother, Yeon Ju, decides to live with Jung Ho for a while.

Episodes.Title: It Was Only You From The Start
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri and Jung Ho come up with a plan to stop Pyun Woong from taking over Dohan Group. Jung Ho’s mother, Yeon Ju, steps in to help. One of Yu Ri’s clients, Hee Yeon, asks Yu Ri to help her solve the mysterious message that her father left behind. Yu Ri, Jung Ho, and the staff of Law Café roll up their sleeves to help her.

Episodes.Title: Between Love And Horror
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri asks Jung Ho to keep their relationship a secret, and Jung Ho agrees to it, although he doesn’t understand why. Woo Jin’s old stalker comes back to give him a nightmare, and Yu Ri gets in danger because of the stalker. Meanwhile, Pyun Woong warns Jung Ho not to mess with him.

Episodes.Title: Even If Life Deceives You
Episodes.Description: Song Hwa, who’s been working as an assemblyman’s secretary, confesses to Yu Ri that she’s been suffering from sexual harassment. Yu Ri offers to help, but Jung Ho isn’t too glad about it because it could hurt Yu Ri. It turns out Pyun Woong is involved with the assemblyman, so Jung Ho decides to step in and help both Yu Ri and Song Hwa.

Episodes.Title: The Day Of Joy Will Surely Come
Episodes.Description: The recording of Assembly Choi harassing Song Hwa gets played in the event he was hosting. The media outlets hammer him, and the investigation against him starts. Jung Ho’s grandfather sets him up on a blind date without his knowledge, and it pushes him to propose to Yu Ri faster.

Episodes.Title: Promise, To Pledge And Bind
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri turns down Jung Ho’s proposal, knowing that she cannot fully trust a promise made by anyone. Jung Ho tells her that she can take her time and that he will wait. Lee Pyun Woong runs away after threatening to kill his father. Then he goes on to kidnap Yu Ri’s mother to get revenge on Jung Ho and Yu Ri.

Episodes.Title: Love, According To The Law
Episodes.Description: After seeing Jung Ho’s parents and Jin Gi and Se Yeon reconcile, Yu Ri changes her mind about marriage and asks Jung Ho to marry her. Lee Pyun Woong asks Yu Ri to be his attorney, but Yu Ri tells him that she can’t because of her beliefs. On the day of Yu Ri and Jung Ho’s wedding, an unexpected thing happens, making every guest flustered.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Han Jae-hui pursues Shin Gyeong-ho for the hit-and-run, while Han-jun guarantees that he'll let the man walk scot-free.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Han-jun sets his next target. Jae-hui visits the café with questions about an old case. Minamdang’s origin story is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Han-jun presses Jung Cheong-gi to give up a name. A witness comes to Jae-hui to confess. Minamdang receives an urgent call about a ghost.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Han-jun and Jae-hui butt heads as they keep getting in the way of each other’s investigations. A familiar face shows up at the crime scene.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Han Jae-jeong’s discovery remains in the dark. Jae-hui seeks to verify Choi Yeong-seop’s alibi. Han-jun goes undercover.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Han-jun acquires a DNA sample. A person haunted by an ex’s ghost visits Minamdang. Jae-hui follows a lead into Joyce Entertainment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Lee Ji-eun opens up about a horrifying scene she witnessed. Han-jun and Jae-hui compete for a phone. A man with a distinct feature catches Han-jun’s eye.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The police interrogation faces an uphill climb. Bad luck follows Jeon Gyeong-cheol. Gu Tae-su seeks a shaman for advice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Tae-su agrees to a DNA test. Han-jun unravels a mystery while in a holding cell. The Minamdang crew try their luck at an underground gambling arena.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Han-jun provokes Park Jin-sang into giving up a name. Jae-hui accompanies Cha Do-won to an exclusive event as his plus-one. Aunt Im expects a visitor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Jae-hui chases after Han-jun's kidnapper; the near-death experience sparks a romance. Jang Du-jin salvages a photo from the debris of a scorched home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: The Minamdang crew examines the evidence Jae-hui had acquired from Tae-su’s trailer and sneaks into a popular nightclub for more answers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: The interrogation proves difficult as Tae-su takes the fall and refuses to give up any names. Han-jun heads to a campsite to take a break from it all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Han-jun and Jae-hui go after the two key players in the scheme who got away. A murder investigation triggers Cha Do-won’s past trauma.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Han-jun closes in on Cha Seung-won and finds out that Aunt Im possesses an important document. But his unorthodox methods shake Jae-hui's trust in him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: After being caught red-handed, Han-jun retraces his steps to come to a shocking realization. A phone call stirs suspicion within Jae-hui’s team.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Han-jun and Jae-hui search the killer’s belongings for more clues. When they come across a hit list, they realize that the murder spree is still ongoing.
