Entries.Title: Summer Strike
Entries.Description: It has been more than four years since Yeo-reum started working at her current job, but she's still the same pushover that she was four years ago. Things have changed for the worse for Yeo-reum with her mom gone, and she finally seeks a change. One day, she realizes that there is another world than the one she's been desperately clinging to and decides to take a different path.

Episodes.Title: An Underpaid Pushover At Work
Episodes.Description: It has been more than four years since Yeo-reum started working at her current job, but she's still the same pushover that she was four years ago. Things have changed for the worse for Yeo-reum with her mom gone, and she finally seeks a change. One day, she realizes that there is another world than the one she's been desperately clinging to and decides to take a different path.

Episodes.Title: The Perfect Place for a New Beginning
Episodes.Description: After two days of doing nothing and being unemployed, Yeo-reum decides to move on and out. With a bag on her back full of all her essential daily necessities, she arrives in a small village called “Angok.” She first looks for a place to stay, and she ends up finding the perfect place within her budget. The next day, satisfied and relieved to see herself making some kind of progress, she gets a little too loosened up.

Episodes.Title: The Outsider of Angok
Episodes.Description: Strange things have been happening to Yeo-reum since she moved into her new place. She gets the sense that some people in Angok want her to leave. Meanwhile, Yeo-reum plucks up the courage to get to know the librarian better. While in Seoul with Ji-young, Dae-beom runs into people he's been desperately avoiding for some reason.

Episodes.Title: Meet Yeo Reum, the Drunk
Episodes.Description: Yeo-reum wakes up feeling sick in the morning and tries to remember what exactly happened last night. While doing so, she realizes that she has withdrawn all the money she had in the bank account. She scavenges the streets of Angok to find the missing plastic bag of money. Later, Dae-beom comes to look for Yeo-reum to tell her something before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: Someone To Talk To
Episodes.Description: Yeo-reum's old boyfriend was not someone she could talk to when she really needed to. But with Dae-beom, she feels like she can share everything. Bom deserves proper care from her parents as a juvenile, and the lack of it puts her in a vulnerable position. With no place to spend the night, Bom lingers outside Yeo-reum's place. Yeo-reum doesn't ask why she's here and puts her arms around her.

Episodes.Title: Things That You Realize Only When It's Too Late
Episodes.Description: When Bom was a little kid, her world revolved around her dad. But now, her dad is the only thing that makes her life miserable. One day, Bom goes through something awful while trying to stop her dad from making a costly mistake. After hearing about the incident, everyone in Angok rushes to their loved ones before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: Dae Bum’s Trauma and Relapse
Episodes.Description: Dae-beom and Yeo-reum get closer by the day, and it is not easy for Ji-young to watch them from afar. One day, Dae-beom takes Yeo-reum home after having a great time together, and he runs into writings regarding her sister on the wall of Sunah Billiard. Yeo-reum is worried about him, but that's about all she can do for him. The next day, Dae-beom does not show up at the library.

Episodes.Title: Different Ways of Seeking Happiness
Episodes.Description: Yeo-reum's previous version of life before coming to Angok was focused on sacrificing her own good for others' happiness. This time, she might be going through a similar situation, and she has to make a choice. A great time with Dae-beom, Bom, and Jae-hoon is what Yeo-reum hoped for since leaving Seoul, and she does not want to lose it.

Episodes.Title: There Is an End to Everything
Episodes.Description: Yeo-reum is satisfied with her life in Angok with Bom, Bom's grandmother, and, of course, Dae-beom by her side. Every day seems too peaceful to be true until something happens. Yeo-reum is on her way back from a date with Dae-beom, and Bom is also back home late that night. However, Bom's grandmother is nowhere to be seen.

Episodes.Title: Leaving Angok
Episodes.Description: Bom's grandmother, Jung Young-sook, dies, leaving Bom and her family devastated. The suspect, Geun-ho, gets arrested and later confesses to the murder. Meanwhile, Yeo-reum decides to leave Angok without telling Dae-beom.

Episodes.Title: The Truth
Episodes.Description: Yeo-reum visits Geun-ho in jail, but she finds something off. Later, she learns that he’s not capable of writing such awful things on the walls and hurting Ms. Jung. Meanwhile, Dae-beom finally understands the meaning of the writings on the wall and figures out the actual culprit behind his sister’s murder.

Episodes.Title: The Meaning Of Happiness
Episodes.Description: Yeo-reum confronts Mr. Kwak and accuses him of killing Ms. Jung. Dae-beom figures out that it was Moo-chul who killed his sister. Bom’s father abandons Bom and Ha-neul to gamble, leaving Bom devastated. After everything comes to an end, Yeo-reum redefines what happiness means.

Entries.Title: Anna
Entries.Description: Yu-mi is the only daughter of a poor family, but she gets everyone’s attention due to her exceptional beauty and talent. At the place where she finds work in order to make a living, she meets Hyun-joo, a woman who was born rich, and Yu-mi feels a sense of deprivation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Yu-mi is the only daughter of a poor family, but she gets everyone’s attention due to her exceptional beauty and talent. At the place where she finds work in order to make a living, she meets Hyun-joo, a woman who was born rich, and Yu-mi feels a sense of deprivation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Yu-mi gets a job by using Hyun-joo’s university degree and even imitates the way Hyun-joo lives. After marrying a promising businessman named Ji-hoon, Yu-mi is satisfied with her life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yu-mi runs into Hyun-joo whom she had completely forgotten about. After that, Yu-mi lives every day in anxiousness. Meanwhile, Ji-won starts to get suspicious about Yu-mi’s past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: As Ji-hoon reaches closer to success, Yu-mi also receives the attention of the public. When Hyun-joo finds out Yu-mi stole her identity, Yu-mi’s cornered.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The relationship between Yu-mi and Ji-hoon worsen, and a scandal about Ji-hoon’s private life is exposed. Meanwhile, Yu-mi is confused about her identity while also feeling guilty toward Hyun-joo. She believes everything’s going wrong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Since Yu-mi can’t be controlled anymore, Ji-hoon plans to send her to a place where she’s cut off from the rest of the world. Yu-mi finds out about Ji-hoon’s plan and she also tries to execute her own plan through Ji-won.

Entries.Title: Blind
Entries.Description: A young university student Baek Ji-eun gets kidnapped and killed. The investigating detective is Sung-jun and the judge of this case also happens to be his brother, Sung-hoon. Although Sung-jun finds a suspect, the court is not sure whether he is the real culprit or not. As the trial proceeds with a jury, the case draws a lot of attention.

Episodes.Title: Crazy Dog
Episodes.Description: A young university student Baek Ji-eun gets kidnapped and killed. The investigating detective is Sung-jun and the judge of this case also happens to be his brother, Sung-hoon. Although Sung-jun finds a suspect, the court is not sure whether he is the real culprit or not. As the trial proceeds with a jury, the case draws a lot of attention.

Episodes.Title: You Should Give Up Hope As Long as You're in Here
Episodes.Description: The jury reaches a verdict that Man-chun is guilty and is sentenced to a lifetime in prison. Just when everyone believes that it is now over, Man-chun manages to escape from his convoy and searches for the jurors to seek revenge. However, his vengeance fails and the truth behind the Joker Murder reveals itself.

Episodes.Title: The Children Who He Abandoned
Episodes.Description: Sung-jun wakes up after getting hurt from the hostage situation. But the only things that greet him are his parents’ nagging and the news of another woman’s death. While the public believes the second murder is done by a copycat killer, Sung-hoon gets a hunch that Man-chun is innocent and that there truly is someone else behind the Joker cases.

Episodes.Title: A Very Old Future
Episodes.Description: The jurors are being targeted as the Joker murderer’s victims. As Ki-nam and Moon-kang learn that the cases are related to Hope Welfare, they collect evidence to find their daughters’ killer. Eventually, their investigation leads to the idea that Ryu Sung-jun might be Jung Yoon-jae. Believing this as a fact, Moon-kang kidnaps Sung-jun.

Episodes.Title: A Certain Promise
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun manages to escape from Moon Kang thanks to Eun Ki. As she believes that Sung Jun is not the killer of the Joker Murders, she helps him clear his name. However, the public and the police are certain that he is the culprit. Being chased by his own colleagues, he must prove that he did not kill anyone.

Episodes.Title: The Enemy Is Near
Episodes.Description: Sung Hoon believes that Sung Jun is not the culprit. Not because they are brothers, but because the current evidence is not enough, and that new evidence starts emerging. Kwon Yu Na gets attacked by Choi Soon Gil. As he is one of the suspects in Yeom Hye Jin’s murder, Sung Jun begins digging into him deeper.

Episodes.Title: The Children Who are Called by Numbers
Episodes.Description: The jurors gather at Kang Young Ki's daughter's wedding while new clues put them into disarray. With everyone gathered, another incident ensues and makes everyone anxious. Was everything planned in detail to get the jurors together from the start?

Episodes.Title: Murder Notice
Episodes.Description: The murder at the wedding has everyone scrambling. An Tae Ho gets spotted on surveillance footage, and the police put an APB on him. Meanwhile, Sung Jun chases after An Tae Ho but loses him. Later, a strange text message gets sent to everyone, making the situation dire.

Episodes.Title: Square One
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun and Sung Hoon are too late, and the "Save Me" event ends in tragedy. However, it's still not over. They get confronted by Moon Kang and his men and almost lose their lives. Luckily, the police arrive just in time, but Sung Jun get taken into custody.

Episodes.Title: The Child Who Survived
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun finds out Eun Ki's mother had worked as a nurse at Hope Welfare Center. To further investigate, Sung Jun goes to meet her. When he finds her, Eun Ki's mother shakes nervously. That night, Sung Jun senses that Eun Ki could be in danger and races to the children's center to see her. Will something happen to Eun Ki?

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Suspicion
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun tracks down Sung Hoon to save Eun Ki, but his suspicions are wrong. However, Sung Hoon's story doesn't add up, and Sung Jun still feels like Sung Hoon is hiding something. While tailing his brother, the man in black suddenly appears before him.

Episodes.Title: Another Person’s Life
Episodes.Description: Sung Hoon recovers in the hospital after getting stabbed by the culprit. Sung Jun confronts Chief Yeom about Hope Welfare Center and gets told to find out from his mother, Minister Na Guk Hee. Meanwhile, Eun Ki sees Yu Na's dying message and hopes it isn't the person she thinks it is. Later Sung Jun finds evidence that it's the same person at a different location.

Episodes.Title: The People Who Disappeared
Episodes.Description: Eight people, including Eun Ki, suddenly disappear. Could the culprit they've been after all this time be responsible for gathering the eight people in one location? Or could it be a different culprit? Will Sung Jun be able to save the eight people's lives?

Episodes.Title: In Search For Lost Time
Episodes.Description: The eight people held captive and on the brink of death make it out alive. Sung Jun arrests Jung In Seong and takes him into custody. However, he needs more evidence to connect him to the other serial murders. He looks to Sung Hoon for help and manages to get a lead. Meanwhile, Eun Ki proposes exposing the truth about Hope Welfare Center to Sung Hoon.

Episodes.Title: The Designer
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun regains his memory. His suspicions against his brother were true. He questions Jung In Seong for more answers to guess Sung Hoon's next move. Meanwhile, shortly after Sung Jun learns through a court sentencing that the presiding judge of the Hope Welfare Center case twenty years ago was his father, Ryu Il Ho, he rushes to find him.

Episodes.Title: The Final Judgement
Episodes.Description: It turns out Sung Hoon and Sung Jun’s parents are taking a big part in the secret behind Hope Welfare Center. Despite the sorrow, Sung Jun must arrest both of his own parents. After their arrest, Sung Hoon also gets arrested for the murders. Regardless of the judgment that he will get, he is relieved to fulfill his lifelong revenge.

Entries.Title: Unlock My Boss
Entries.Description: After a bitter struggle to get a job, In-seong is faced with the painful reality. Moving back with his parents, he picks up a smartphone, which happens to say it’s CEO Kim Seon-ju of Silver Lining locked up in the phone. Is this some kind of new scam? Right then, the phone asks him to act for the CEO of Silver Lining.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After a bitter struggle to get a job, In-seong is faced with the painful reality. Moving back with his parents, he picks up a smartphone, which happens to say it’s CEO Kim Seon-ju of Silver Lining locked up in the phone. Is this some kind of new scam? Right then, the phone asks him to act for the CEO of Silver Lining.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Becoming a CEO overnight, In-seong corrects injustice with the absolute power he gained on the first day at work. As he tracks Seon-ju’s whereabouts on the day of the accident, suspicion against Ms. Jung, who may be a reliable ally or a deadly enemy, starts to grow.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While In-seong is confused by the texts and call from the unknown number, Seon-ju believes it’s a chance to track the caller. On the day of the meeting where Silver Lining’s enemies within and out are gathered, In-seong collects all executives’ phones using security as an excuse. As he calls the unknown number back, one of the phones rings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In-seong and Se-yeon now shares the secret about Seon-ju trapped in a smartphone. The closer they get to the truth, the bigger the suspicion against him grows. Bumyoung’s executive director, Mi-ran’s advice, “Don’t trust Kim Seon-ju too much” keeps bothering In-seong, and he ends up checking out the place where Seon-ju went missing. There, he encounters a mysterious man.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After CEO Oh Bum-geun passes away, the fight to become his successor becomes more tense and the threat against In-seong and Se-yeon grows. In-seong wants to hire a security guard, but for some reason Se-yeon disagrees.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: In-seong is determined to catch the real culprit after he sees how much Min-ah misses her dad. He manages to corner Mr. Kwak, who had the answer to everything, but something unbelievable happens.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Witnessing death before his eyes, In-seong gets shocked. He goes back to his hometown to protect himself and his family, which are more precious to him than one billion won Seon-ju had promised. After realizing he wasn’t driven only by money, he comes back and starts investigating who attacked Mr. Kwak.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The subordinate takes Seon-ju’s smartphone from In-seong, but it was In-seong’s plan to catch the one behind him. Without Seon-ju, In-seong learns what burden a CEO must bear on his shoulders. Meanwhile, Seon-ju is taken to his enemies’ base by the subordinate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: With the help of Seon-ju inside the smartphone, In-seong discovers Seon-ju’s body in their enemies’ base. Everything starts to fall into place and In-seong finds out who is behind all this. Then he draws up a plan to play one enemy off against another.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: As Bumyoung stands firm, In-seong holds a shareholders’ meeting to take down and bring the executive to justice. However, the power game turns out to be much more complicated than he thought. While In-seong is about to be removed from his post, MG starts searching for Kim Seon-ju alone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Getting the CEO position back, In-seong feels the absence of his partner who has always been by his side. But there’s no time to be sad. In-seong negotiates a deal to get Seon-ju’s body back, not knowing what consequences it will lead him to.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Does he see what he believes, or believe what he sees? As In-seong finally solves the puzzle of “Kim Seon-ju, a smartphone, and Baro 4.0,” he prepares for the last battle with Bumyoung. On the day of the self-driving vehicle test-drive, In-seong sets out on a deadly race while the entire nation is watching.

Entries.Title: If You Wish Upon Me
Entries.Description: The former captain of Team Genie is facing his last moments of life. To grant his final wish, Tae-shik and Yeon-joo take him to his hometown, the East Sea. On the way there, they run into Gyeo-re who is running away from his enemies. Although they meet by accident, their fate binds them together at the hospice hospital.

Episodes.Title: Team Genie
Episodes.Description: The former captain of Team Genie is facing his last moments of life. To grant his final wish, Tae-shik and Yeon-joo take him to his hometown, the East Sea. On the way there, they run into Gyeo-re who is running away from his enemies. Although they meet by accident, their fate binds them together at the hospice hospital.

Episodes.Title: The Awful Driver
Episodes.Description: The new volunteer who will be driving the ambulance is Gyeo-re. Although Yeon-joo does not like the idea, Tae-shik brings him here so he can learn a lesson. The first patient he will be driving is Mr. Pyeon, who might die in a week. Team Genie brings him to his old home as he wishes to face his last moment where he has his most beautiful memories.

Episodes.Title: Unbearable Pain
Episodes.Description: Yong-ho now faces the last moments of his life. Watching him pass makes Gyeo-re feel something he never felt before. A young patient fights extreme pain due to cancer. For the girl who is not sure whether to live in pain is better than dying, Tae-shik tries his best to grant her final wish.

Episodes.Title: Se-hee's Last Wish
Episodes.Description: Although Tae-shik’s attempt to persuade Gyu-tae seems meaningless, Gyu-tae suddenly changes his mind for some reason. Hence, the preparations for Se-hee’s musical officially begin. Meanwhile, Gyeo-re is still obsessed with what is in Room 403. Although he knows that the ghost is a lie, he is still curious.

Episodes.Title: The Suspicion
Episodes.Description: Se-hee’s final wish ends with a success. Her musical brings her loved ones together and also helps Gyu-tae to repent. Meanwhile, Gyeo-re finds some suspicious things about Mr. Kang. Although Team Genie is a charity group, he sees Mr. Kang receive money from Se-hee’s parents.

Episodes.Title: Seo-jin's Revenge
Episodes.Description: Jun-kyung is now out of prison. Although Seok-jun finds her to get to Gyeo-re, she is also unable to reach him. Seo-jin’s boyfriend becomes the victim of a hit-and-run case. Not knowing when he might die, he whispers his final wish to Seo-jin. As the wish is something Tae-shik refuses to do, she acts on her own with some help from Gyeo-re.

Episodes.Title: Yeon-joo and Gyeo-re
Episodes.Description: Gyeo-re expresses his feelings toward Yeon-joo for the first time. Although the timing is not intentional, he still means what he said. However, Jun-kyung is close to finding Gyeo-re. She visits Jin-gu but leaves empty-handed. As Seok-jun and Jun-kyung are in the brisk of finding Gyeo-re, tension surrounds the hospice hospital.

Episodes.Title: Farewell Sonny
Episodes.Description: It is now time for Sonny to have his final wish. Although Gyeo-re thought that Sonny wants to take revenge on his previous owner, he realizes that it is not what Sonny wants. After his death, Gyeo-re pursues happiness at the hospice hospital. Sonny and the people at the hospital teach him what it is like to have a family.

Episodes.Title: Brother And Sister
Episodes.Description: Jun-kyung finds Gyeo-re at the hospital. By threatening him that she will die, he follows her against his will. Even without saying goodbye, Gyeo-re leaves the hospital and breaks Yeon-joo’s heart. Although the brother and sister live together as a family now, every day is nothing but torment for the both of them.

Episodes.Title: Back Home
Episodes.Description: Gyeo-re is able to escape Jun-kyung and come back home safely thanks to Yeon-joo. As he returns to the hospital, he becomes certain that this is where he belongs. Tae-shik’s cancer is getting worse. Yeon-joo is worried that he might not have much time left and that he is still unaware of the secret of Room 403.

Episodes.Title: Tae-shik's Cancer
Episodes.Description: On the way to Mokpo to fulfill Chang-woo’s final wish, Tae-shik collapses because of his cancer. Although he is fine for now, he promises Gyeo-re and Yeon-joo that he will receive chemotherapy once they return to the hospice. Meanwhile, the secret behind the patient in Room 403 starts to uncover itself slowly.

Episodes.Title: The Children Left Behind
Episodes.Description: Jae-yeon and Ho-yeon are scared that they will be left alone if their grandmother passes. However, Gyeo-re feeds them and gives them work to do in the hospice. Meanwhile, the man in Room 403 wakes up and talks to Gyeo-re. He wishes to leave the hospital once he gets his memories back.

Episodes.Title: Father And Son
Episodes.Description: Jae-yeon and Ho-yeon’s grandmother passes. Although Gyeo-re wishes to take them in, they already have an Auntie who wants to take care of them. Meanwhile, it turns out that Yoon Ki-chun has never lost his memories in the first place. Without anyone knowing, he plans an evil scheme in the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Ill-Fated Relationship
Episodes.Description: Yoon Ki-chun calls upon his gang to the hospital. He is still the man he used to be and plans to take away everything that Tae-shik loves. Meanwhile, Tae-shik helps Jun-kyung to be free from despair. With his help, she learns the truth behind the reason why she ended up in an orphanage.

Episodes.Title: A Real Family
Episodes.Description: Ki-chun and Tae-shik become hospitalized. While Ki-chun is bleeding out, Tae-shik’s cancer becomes worse as his body is severely injured. Meanwhile, Gyeo-re finally ends his relationship with Ki-chun. With nobody to bother him anymore, he goes back to where he truly belongs in Woori Hospice Hospital.

Episodes.Title: The Little Captain
Episodes.Description: The time for Tae-shik’s final wish has come. Although Gyeo-re thought it is to hold Tae-shik’s early funeral, it is actually a different event for Gyeo-re. After Tae-shik’s passing, his will to help those in need does not change. The hospital makes a foundation that helps Team Genie to grant people’s wishes more actively.

Entries.Title: Poong The Joseon Psychiatrist
Entries.Description: Se Poong’s treatment of the Crown Prince gets him respect from His Majesty himself, and he gets the title “Divine Needle”. However, things go terribly wrong when he treats His Majesty. Se Poong blames himself for the tragic outcome, but Yoo Hoo Myung, his father, looks further into the case and finds evidence of the king’s poisoning. Unfortunately, Hoo Myung passes away without being able to close the case. With hardships piling up, Se Poong even gets exiled from Hanyang.

Episodes.Title: Se Poong, the Divine Needle
Episodes.Description: Se Poong’s treatment of the Crown Prince gets him respect from His Majesty himself, and he gets the title “Divine Needle”. However, things go terribly wrong when he treats His Majesty. Se Poong blames himself for the tragic outcome, but Yoo Hoo Myung, his father, looks further into the case and finds evidence of the king’s poisoning. Unfortunately, Hoo Myung passes away without being able to close the case. With hardships piling up, Se Poong even gets exiled from Hanyang.

Episodes.Title: Eun Woo Covered in Blood
Episodes.Description: Se Yeob recognizes who the lady covered in blood is the moment he sees her. However, he is in no shape to save her himself. Not long after, Eun Woo is brought to Gyesoo Clinic again in a critical state. This worries Se Yeob, and he decides that he should look into whatever it is that’s causing her to harm herself. Meanwhile, it seems like there is a reason why Granny keeps calling Se Yeob by the name “Poong”.

Episodes.Title: Gumiho In Sorak Village
Episodes.Description: The appearance of Gumiho tears up Sorak Village, but a little girl is accused of being Gumiho herself. Se Poong and Eun Woo look into the case, believing that a little girl could not have murdered two full-grown men. Meanwhile, a royal inspector dispatched to Sorak Village with a side task begins to look for a man named “Yoo Se Yeob.”

Episodes.Title: Se Poong’s Painful Past
Episodes.Description: Se Poong is flustered when his painful memories are brought up again right in front of him, and it torments him. Meanwhile, a lady suffering from hand tremors visits Gyesoo Clinic, and this eventually leads to a tragic situation for Man Bok. Unless Se Poong and the others do something quickly, Man Bok, Se Poong’s only friend, might lose his life.

Episodes.Title: Saving Man Bok
Episodes.Description: Time is ticking for Se Poong and Eun Woo to save Man Bok, and they struggle to reveal the truth behind Gae Ban’s death. Meanwhile, a rumor starts to spread on the streets that the King’s death was caused by a mysterious poisoning, and those who are behind the King’s death begin to take measures to cover the tracks.

Episodes.Title: The Intimacy Between Se Poong And Eun Woo
Episodes.Description: Se Poong and Eun Woo make up for each other’s shortcomings as they continue with their journey of treating and helping people in need. Sin Woo watches them from afar, and their intimacy is just too unbearable for him to handle. Meanwhile, the truth behind the night of the deceased King’s death remains in the dark.

Episodes.Title: The Secrets Behind Haedongboncho
Episodes.Description: Realizing that Haedongboncho has something to do with his father’s death, Se Poong looks for anything that is related to it. While doing so, he also figures out that Gye Ji Han actually knows who he is and who his father was. In the meantime, Gyesoo Clinic is on the verge of being sold at an absurd price due to a secret that Ji Han doesn’t want to reveal.

Episodes.Title: The Plague At Sorak Village
Episodes.Description: As the plague spreads throughout Sorak Village, those who are infected are on the verge of being burned alive just for the purpose of stopping the contagion. While treating the neglected patients, even Eun Woo gets infected, and Se Poong chooses to risk everything to save her. Meanwhile, Ji Han seems to be the only one who knows enough about the plague, but he just won’t say a word about it.

Episodes.Title: Se Poong’s Chance To Live
Episodes.Description: Sin Woo offers Se Poong a chance to run away before he takes Se Poong’s life. However, Se Poong stands by his principles and decides to stay, believing that Gyesoo Clinic is now where he belongs. Meanwhile, Eun Woo gets assaulted by a stranger. While looking into the incident, Se Poong and Eun Woo both end up expressing the feelings they’ve been struggling to share.

Episodes.Title: Se Poong’s Old Friend
Episodes.Description: After hearing about Sin Woo’s disappearance, Se Poong and Eun Woo feel that something just doesn’t add up and start looking for Sin Woo and eventually find him in a fatal condition. While taking care of him in secret, an old friend of Se Poong’s makes a surprise visit with an even more surprising message. At the same time, the opposing party looks for Se Poong to end his life.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Hope
Episodes.Description: The truth is never easily revealed when people are risking their lives to hide it. The only person who knows and can prove the truth has died right in front of Se Poong’s eyes, and it puts him in despair. However, nothing will make him back down unless he fulfills the duty given to him by His Majesty. Hanyang is his next destination, and this time Eun Woo accompanies him. Meanwhile, Commander Im proceeds with his plan to tear down Gyesoo Clinic.

Episodes.Title: The Judgement Day
Episodes.Description: Se Poong acquires all the proof he needs to bring the evil ones to justice. If he succeeds, this will allow him to clear his name. However, even with apparent evidence, the corrupted ones won’t go down without putting up a fight. Meanwhile, seeing Se Poong risking everything to do what’s right worries Eun Woo.

Episodes.Title: Yoo Se Poong And Gyesoo Clinic In Hanyang
Episodes.Description: Se Poong and the people of Gyesoo Clinic are now in Hanyang, and as expected, everyone feels relieved by their very existence. However, Se Poong is not all that pleased. Not being able to be with Eun Woo, Se Poong feels a void in his heart. As soon as Eun Woo arrives in Hanyang, the symptoms of His Majesty worsen, and the two get right on it. While looking for the cause of the disease, they run into their rivals.

Episodes.Title: The Living Ghost
Episodes.Description: The cause of the epidemic that was spread inside and outside the palace seemed impossible to be found until Se Poong and Eun Woo caught a court lady stealing the palace’s liquor. Se Poong quickly takes action and stops the spread of the disease. Meanwhile, the identity of the ghost gets revealed when it enters the King’s chamber to attack him during his sleep.

Episodes.Title: Momentary Peacefulness At Gyesoo Clinic
Episodes.Description: The members of Gyesoo Clinic are finally back in Sorak Village, and they enjoy the peacefulness of the village as they settle in. Unfortunately, before they even get a chance to simmer down, Jeon Kang Il and Princess Seo Yi show up at the clinic, making it painful and uncomfortable for the Gyesoo Clinic family to stay there even for a second.

Episodes.Title: The Story of So Cheon
Episodes.Description: Kang Il accuses Se Poong of failing to treat his patient, So Cheon, who even ends up attempting to kill herself. Princess Seo Yi proactively helps Se Poong clear his name by finding a lead in So Cheon’s case. So Cheon musters up her courage and tells Se Poong and Eun Woo what exactly happened to her.

Episodes.Title: All Princess Seo Yi Wants Is Se Poong
Episodes.Description: To Princess Seo Yi, nothing matters as long as she can wed Se Poong, and this causes a tilt in the well-balanced relationship between Se Poong and Eun Woo. Se Poong watches the Princess closely and finds a certain pattern in her behaviour, but it’s still not enough to cure her. Se Poong eventually obtains some of the missing pieces to the Princess' puzzle during his trip to Hanyang.

Episodes.Title: Whose Daughter Is Ip Bun?
Episodes.Description: Kang Il comes back to Gyesoo Clinic, all injured. Physician Gye and Se Poong devote themselves to look after him. Governor Ahn remembers who Physician Gye and Ip Bun are. He demands Ip Bun be returned to where she belongs. Meanwhile, Kang Il talks the governor into writing a petition about Se Poong.

Episodes.Title: Se Poong And His Annulment
Episodes.Description: Se Poong is on the verge of losing all his titles and honors due to District Governor Ahn’s scheme. However, he refuses to submit to wrongful accusations. Physician Gye believes it’s safe for Se Poong and Eun Woo to be cautious, so he separates them for the time being. Lady Eun Woo visits a pregnant patient’s house for an emergency house call, but it’s already past the absurd curfew set by Governor Ahn.

Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Se Poong’s Return to Gyesoo Clinic
Episodes.Description: Feeling comfortable and content with each other by their sides, Se Poong and Eun Woo return to Gyesoo Clinic. However, Governor Ahn has been cooking up a scheme to completely bring Se Poong down, and at this rate, it is inevitable that Se Poong will fall into his trap. Unfortunately, by the time Se Poong realizes something is wrong, he's already in too deep.

Episodes.Title: What Being A True Physician Means
Episodes.Description: After Governor Ahn’s failed attempt to harm Se Poong, he gets locked up in jail. Kang Il recovers from injuries and reports to the King what Governor Ahn did. Se Poong gets appointed as the head of the Medical Office and helps Eun Woo become a palace physician as well. Meanwhile, Granny prepares a gift for everyone before her long journey.

Entries.Title: The Sound of Magic
Entries.Description: Yoon Ah-yi’s silent scream for help is answered by Ri-eul, who appears before her during a time of need and makes her wonder: is he really a magician?

Episodes.Title: Do you... believe in magic?
Episodes.Description: Yoon Ah-yi’s silent scream for help is answered by Ri-eul, who appears before her during a time of need and makes her wonder: is he really a magician?

Episodes.Title: Don't let me dream any longer
Episodes.Description: Set on exposing Ri-eul's secrets, Baek Ha-na enters the theme park with a camera and captures Ah-yi inside. Na Il-deung asks Ah-yi on a study date.

Episodes.Title: Merry-go-round
Episodes.Description: Il-deung and Ah-yi make a deal to try to make each other's lives easier. Suspicious about Ri-eul, Il-deung secretly follows Ah-yi to her magic lessons.

Episodes.Title: Becoming an adult
Episodes.Description: Il-deung begins questioning his path. Ha-na discovers shocking footage in the hidden camera from Ri-eul's room. Ah-yi finds comfort from the future.

Episodes.Title: Curse of asphalt
Episodes.Description: Ha-na infuriates Ri-eul by snooping for evidence in his room. The police ask Ah-yi questions about a caped person of interest.

Episodes.Title: The last performance
Episodes.Description: Through a longtime friend, Ah-yi and Il-deung learn of Ryu Min-hyuk's pained past. The magician disappears from the interrogation room.

Entries.Title: Lookism
Entries.Description: After enduring years of abuse from his peers, Park Hyeong-seok moves to a different neighborhood to start a new life. Big changes are coming for him.

Episodes.Title: Change
Episodes.Description: After enduring years of abuse from his peers, Park Hyeong-seok moves to a different neighborhood to start a new life. Big changes are coming for him.

Episodes.Title: New Life
Episodes.Description: Hyeong-seok attends school in his new body by day and works a part-time job as his true self by night – only to learn that nothing has really changed.

Episodes.Title: Friends
Episodes.Description: A student by the nickname Basco helps the old Hyeong-seok fight off bullies, while the new Hyeong-seok hangs out with his first-ever group of friends.

Episodes.Title: Mom
Episodes.Description: Hyeong-seok takes his mother out to a cafe as his transformed self. Basco seethes with righteous indignation when he spots the two together.

Episodes.Title: Kindness
Episodes.Description: Hyeong-seok lends a hand to other struggling peers in school, while an enigmatic classmate offers him help and gifts when he needs it most.

Episodes.Title: Recommendation
Episodes.Description: Pyeon Deok-hwa considers performing at the school festival, while others in his class relentlessly try to trample on his dream of becoming a rap artist.

Episodes.Title: Special Training
Episodes.Description: Under Deok-hwa’s direction, Hyeong-seok unlocks his singing potential as their musical collaboration nurtures their blossoming friendship.

Episodes.Title: Wall
Episodes.Description: Competition heats up backstage on the day of the festival. Hyeong-seok and Deok-hwa leave their past and fears behind to deliver a song from the heart.

Entries.Title: Three Bold Siblings
Entries.Description: Tae Ju can't believe her ears sitting with So Rim's soon-to-be husband's family. Her whole life, she has sacrificed herself for her younger siblings and did everything her mother wanted. But this time, it's gone too far. She walks out disturbed and angry. However, the sight of Sang Jun's photo exhibition posters pushes her to her limits.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju can't believe her ears sitting with So Rim's soon-to-be husband's family. Her whole life, she has sacrificed herself for her younger siblings and did everything her mother wanted. But this time, it's gone too far. She walks out disturbed and angry. However, the sight of Sang Jun's photo exhibition posters pushes her to her limits.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju and So Rim get into a big fight over what happened at dinner. However, Tae Ju still wants her out of her apartment. Meanwhile, Sang Jun, a long-time leading role actor, slowly gets pushed out of significant roles. His family, who lived off of his success, wants him to make a comeback by supporting his photo essay book launch.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Luckily for Sang Jun, Tae Ju's spiteful desire saves him from a psychotic stalker out to seriously harm him. The two who once were lovers reunite with opposing emotions. Sang Jun is thrilled, while Tae Ju is full of rage. Meanwhile, Se Ran can't stand the thought of helping family members with their housing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju, who had suffered a long time because of Sang Jun, doesn't find the reunion with him at all pleasant. However, her heart becomes agitated when he tells her sincerely that he has loved her all along. Meanwhile, Sang Jun learns about a secret in Gun Woo's relationship and gets troubled by it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju realizes that everything that happens is only for the show, but she’s not sure if her feelings realize them too. As they move further into the filming, Sang Jun’s unpredictable behaviors continue to make Tae Ju’s heart beat faster. Meanwhile, Se Ran is not happy with the fact that Tae Ju is Sang Jun’s reality-show partner, and Jung Sook hates everything about Sang Jun and his family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: What is supposed to be a well-planned dating show between Tae Ju and Sang Jun turns into another stressful issue she has to face. Although it is true that it bothers her, she does have mixed feelings about the incident. To make things worse, Tae Ju gets a call from Se Ran. Meanwhile, So Rim and Tae Ju run into a shocking truth while looking for a new place to live.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun feels the need to make an official and sincere apology to Tae Ju and makes a surprise visit. What is supposed to be a quick apology turns into a mess when Tae Ju’s mother also makes an unannounced visit. Meanwhile, So Rim is unaware of the fact that Nam Soo is two-timing her or that his new girlfriend is one of her students.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju and Myeong Jae, her uncle, spend time together sharing their old memories. After hearing that everything has worked out well for him, Tae Ju couldn’t be happier for him. However, he seems to be in need of a few favors, and Tae Ju gladly agrees to help without knowing how it will affect her. Meanwhile, Sang Jun finds out about what Tae Ju had to go through because of him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju realizes that she was scammed by her uncle. The money she lost to fraud is too much for her to handle, and now she has to move to somewhere cheaper in order to cover the debt. Meanwhile, she runs into someone she never wants to see again on her way out of his house. Sang Jun wants to help Tae Ju, even if it means that he has to accept unwanted roles.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: It didn’t take long before Jung Sook found out about what Tae Ju was going through. After a lengthy conversation with Tae Ju, Jung Sook decides that she should live with her to let her know that she’s not alone. Meanwhile, what Sang Jun expected when he agreed to take the role comes back to haunt him in the most humiliating way possible.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju now realizes how genuine her feelings for Sang Jun are, but for some reason, Sang Jun seems to be avoiding her calls or messages. There is not a single moment of the day when she doesn’t think of Sang Jun, and it is painful to endlessly wait for a call that never comes. Meanwhile, So Rim gets into a brawl with Sang Min and ends up causing inconvenience to Moo Young.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju does not want to waste another second of her life ignoring her true feelings and heads straight to see Sang Jun. However, she ends up causing a scene at Se Ran’s after having too many drinks earlier that night. Meanwhile, Jung Sook’s pleasant stay at Yun Ho’s guesthouse gets interrupted when she gets a call from Se Ran.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Sang Min runs into Tae Ju at the family gathering between her family and her fiance’s. The two argued a little, but everything seemed fine until Sang Min decided to do something monstrous to Tae Ju. Sadly, Sang Min does not realize that this will end up snowballing into something that she will regret for the rest of her life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Sang Min and her husband-to-be do not share mutual friends or relatives, and he has no reason to drag Sang Min into this marriage fraud. It turns out there is one connection that made all this possible. Sang Min is in despair after processing what just happened to her. Meanwhile, Hyun Jung comes close to figuring out that there are people who were aware of this fraud before the wedding.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: A date has been set for Sang Jun’s visit to Tae Ju’s house, but not all members of her family are pleased to hear the news. So Rim feels something special toward one of her members at the Pilates center, but she’s not sure what his feelings are like. At the hospital, Gun Woo runs into the lady he had a crush on when he was a medical student.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Se Ran feels like Tae Ju is taking Sang Jun away from her, and she gives Tae Ju a hard time out of her loneliness and emptiness. The situation is not easy for Sang Jun either, but he faces up to it as a firstborn. Meanwhile, So Rim doesn’t like it when she runs into Nam Soo just outside of her dad’s curry place. So Rim gets a part-time job offer at a cosmetics company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun’s visit to Tae Ju’s house turns into a long-term stay, and Se Ran is shocked when she hears about it. With Sang Jun confidently volunteering to live with Tae Ju and her family for the first two years of marriage, Se Ran collapses. Gun Woo happens to be passing by at the right moment and takes Se Ran home. So Rim is having a hard time at Moo Young’s office due to unpleasant encounters.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun is excited to bring Tae Ju home for the weekend, but at the same time, he’s worried that she would have to go through something awful. Unsurprisingly, Eun Ju and Se Ran put their heads together to turn Tae Ju’s stay into her worst nightmare. Gun Woo takes it one step at a time to show Hyun Jung how sincere his feelings are.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju and Sang Jun hold off telling their families about their marriage registration for the time being, while Jung Sook and Se Ran become closer friends without knowing what Tae Ju and Sang Jun did. Meanwhile, Ji Hye suggests to Moo Young they should have a double date brunch with Nam Soo, and Ji Woo and Soo Bin each claim they have a secret to their childhood.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun and Tae Ju prepare to tell their families about their marriage registration, and Gun Woo visits Happy Pilates to spy on Moo Young. Meanwhile, the secret from the past slowly reveals itself, strangling Se Ran and affecting other people in the house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju shows Sang Jun the mysterious letter she had received. Sang Jun tells Tae Ju he will put bodyguards on her for the time being. Meanwhile, Ji Hye asks So Rim about her ex-boyfriend that works in the company, and So Rim, whose feelings for Mu Yeong have grown, makes a big decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: The Christmas tree Mu Yeong leaves in front of the restaurant causes a commotion within Tae Ju's family. Each of the family members begins to guess who it could be. Meanwhile, Ji Hye thinks Hyun Jung is the woman Mu Yeong has been secretly dating.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: The Christmas tree Mu Yeong leaves in front of the restaurant causes a commotion within Tae Ju's family. Each of the family members begins to guess who it could be. Meanwhile, Ji Hye thinks Hyun Jung is the woman Mu Yeong has been secretly dating.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Nam Soo can’t stop thinking that Mu Yeong’s girlfriend could be So Rim. Sang Min gets a message from Dong Chan and decides that it’s necessary that she talks to him one last time. Meanwhile, Tae Ju gets a chance to introduce her younger brother to Hyun Jung, but she does not know that they are more than just acquainted with each other.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju recognizes Jang Mi who ran into her and Sang Jun while taking a walk around the neighborhood. Eun Ju is shocked when she witnesses this. Sang Min gathers up the whole family for an important announcement. Meanwhile, Mu Yeong musters up the courage to tell So Rim that he misses her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Jang Mi continues to be a nuisance to the people around Sang Jun, and Tae Ju stops someone from vandalizing the restaurant. Meanwhile, Se Ran sends Hyun Jung to Gun Woo's house on an errand, and So Rim falls victim to Nam Soo's plan to destroy her employment at the company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju runs into a strange woman vandalizing the tree in front of Today's Curry and gets into a scuffle. Meanwhile, Nam Soo asks So Rim to meet him, but Gun Woo deals with him instead. While doing so, Gun Woo finds out a few too many things about Mu Yeong and runs back to So Rim, telling her to make sure that she cuts all ties with him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jung is shocked at her pregnancy and tells Tae Ju to keep it a secret for the time being. Later, when Tae Ju goes to stop Hyun Jung from wanting to leave the country alone to raise the child, she learns something unexpected. Meanwhile, Mu Yeong tells So Rim that he will help her with what happened at the company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: It was Sang Jun who found Tae Ju lying on the cold floor of the parking lot near Sang Jun’s house. He immediately takes her to the hospital. Young Sik checks out the security footage before Sang Jun does and delivers the details of the footage to none other than Se Ran. So Rim has a lot on her mind and struggles to hide her feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: After finding out about the relationship between Mu Yeong and So Rim and the fact that she’s what’s breaking them apart, Ji Hye comes up with a plan to reveal how she honestly feels. Meanwhile, Sang Jun feels lost when he realizes that Tae Ju is suffering from short-term memory loss. Gun Woo runs into Hyun Jung in front of her cafe and sees her suddenly collapse to the ground.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun will do whatever it takes to bring Tae Ju’s memories back, and he believes the person caught on the security footage has something to do with the incident. He wants to report the incident to the police, but, for some reason, Se Ran and a few other family members want to cover up the incident. Meanwhile, the family finds out about So Rim’s new boyfriend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Jang Mi barges into Young Sik’s studio to threaten the family with the secret behind Ji Woo. There, Sang Jun learns that he is Ji Woo’s birth father and that Jang Mi is the mother. Although he denies it, the DNA test says otherwise. The fact that Young Sik, Eun Ju, and Se Ran already knew about this makes Sang Jun sick. Tae Ju’s memory loss is not the only problem he has now.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju tries her best to recover her memories of Sang Jun. Meanwhile, Sang Jun has lost his faith in his family and let them know that he will be taking care of his matters moving forward. It was inevitable that Ji Hye would find out about the past relationship between Nam Soo and So Rim, but it might be too late for So Rim to be honest with her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: The only thing Sang Jun can come up with to take care of his mess is sacrificing himself, and he’s willing to lie to Tae Ju to do so. Tae Ju, on the other hand, does not understand Sang Jun’s recent weird behaviour. Meanwhile, Mu Yeong asks Gun Woo more about Nam Soo’s character, and Hyun Jung plans a trip to Chicago without letting Gun Woo know.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju cares about Sang Jun as much as Sang Jun does, and she wants to get to the bottom of the reason for Sang Jun’s rash behaviours. Hyun Jung’s plan to leave Gun Woo fails when he finds out about her departure to Chicago. Gun Woo then tells everyone about his relationship with Hyun Jung, but not everyone is pleased to hear about it. Seung Gu wants to run more paternity tests for Sang Jun’s sake.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: It was inevitable that Tae Ju would find out why Sang Jun was trying so hard to get a divorce. When she does, she doesn’t doubt Sang Jun but wants to get the paternity test done herself. Mal Soon and Jung Sook are at Hyun Jung’s house to get rid of Gun Woo. So Rim has had enough of Nam Soo’s shamelessness and actively participates in exposing how Nam Soo has been abusing his authority while in office.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jung confirms her feelings for Gun Woo through an unexpected accident. On Gipeun Cosmetics' anonymous online forum, a post revealing Mu Yeong and So Rim's relationship causes rumours to spread. Meanwhile, Sang Jun sees someone on his agency's security footage and begins to doubt the authenticity of the positive paternity test results.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Seeing Ji Woo feel excluded from his family reminds Tae Ju of her old days. Sang Jun and Seung Gu are thorough in retaking the DNA paternity test. The results are in, and the first thing Sang Jun does is demand from Young Sik for an explanation. Nam Soo is on the verge of losing his position at the headquarters and is waiting to be relocated.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Ji Hye is glad that her mother is finally back in Korea. Over excited and over zealous, Ji Hye puts her mother on her call with Mu Yeong. Meanwhile, So Rim finally and officially introduces Mu Yeong to her father, and Mu Yeong can’t stop feeling nervous. Hyun Jung and Gun Woo seem to be doing well as they move in together with Gun Woo’s family. Everything is right where it belongs, but Ji Woo struggles to find his place in the world.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: Although Ji Woo is a decent boy who would never do anything rash, the stress that he gets from his family makes him run away from home. Everyone looks for him but he is nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, Mu Yeong’s ex-wife catches him with So Rim at his home. Although he despises her and wants her out of his life, Ji Hye wishes to become family again with her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju and Sang Jun miraculously find Ji Woo at a place where he went on a trip with his family. They decide not to force him back home and let him stay hidden in a safe place until he feels better. Meanwhile, Mu Yeong finally goes to meet So Rim’s family. The siblings greet him and consider him a beloved family member.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Mu Yeong reassures So Rim that everything will be all right after ignoring Hee Eun's terminal illness. Ji Woo spends his time at the guest house and feels closer to Tae Ju than Young Sik. Meanwhile, some people come rushing into Young Sik's studio and ask questions about the past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Reporters from various papers barge into Young Sik's studio unannounced. As they ask for clarification on the issue that Young Sik raised Sang Jun's child, Young Sik tells them it is true. Meanwhile, Tae Ju and Sang Jun take Ji Woo back to the family. He is happy that the curry family is genuinely relieved to see him healthy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: So Rim decides to take over the curry restaurant after breaking up with Mu Yeong and quitting her job. Sang Jun plans to charge Yong Sik through his agency for what he did. Meanwhile, Sang Jun and Hyun Jung intend to get Mu Yeong and So Rim together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju can't believe her ears sitting with So Rim's soon-to-be husband's family. Her whole life, she has sacrificed herself for her younger siblings and did everything her mother wanted. But this time, it's gone too far. She walks out disturbed and angry. However, the sight of Sang Jun's photo exhibition posters pushes her to her limits.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: After the big fight between Se Ran and Young Sik, the family is put into a very tense state. As a doctor and the oldest sibling, Tae Ju does her best to relieve the family stress. Meanwhile, Sang Jun tries to find Kyung Soon to get to the bottom of the misunderstanding. He wants her to confess to Young Sik that she ripped his artwork.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Kyung Soon flees the scene as she finds out that she has been set up. Although it is obvious that she is lying to Young Sik, he still trusts his mother over Sang Jun. Meanwhile, Ji Hye learns that Hee Eun has been faking her illness. The disappointment is already too great for her to take but she also hears that she is not even her father’s biological daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: The revenge on Hee Eun begins with Tae Ju acting as Sang Jun’s proxy. She makes it difficult for Hee Eun to get Sang Jun’s advertisement contract. Meanwhile, Ji Hye asks Sang Min to help her meet Hyun Jung. She deeply regrets what she did with her mom and also wants to know the details about why Mu Yeong took her in as his daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju tries to help Gab Bun recover by giving her guitar lessons. Sang Jun also gives his mother a chance to audition for a role in his new movie. However, the role somehow resembles what Se Ran has done to Sang Jun. Meanwhile, So Rim finally begins to spend a fruitful life with Mu Yeong and Ji Hye.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Now that Hee Eun is gone for good, things for So Rim and Mu Yeong are finally starting to work out. As Ji Hye sincerely apologizes for what she has done, So Rim’s parents decide to forgive her. Meanwhile, the case between Sang Jun and Young Sik doesn’t seem to get any better. Young Sik is still in hiding and Sang Jun still continues on with his movie.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun throws himself to protect Young Sik. Although he can never forgive him, deep down, he still cares for him as a brother. As for Nam Soo and Hee Eun, they are now permanently out of the picture behind bars. The day of Tae Ju and Sang Jun’s marriage has finally come. With all troubles and worries gone, the big family will only have happy days from now.

Entries.Title: Ghost Doctor
Entries.Description: Sensing that Ko Seung-tak, a resident at Eunsang University Medical Center, will not get along with him, Cha Young-min, the top cardiothoracic surgeon, plans to get rid of him.

Episodes.Title: The Finest Cardiothoracic Surgeon
Episodes.Description: Sensing that Ko Seung-tak, a resident at Eunsang University Medical Center, will not get along with him, Cha Young-min, the top cardiothoracic surgeon, plans to get rid of him.

Episodes.Title: A Coma Ghost
Episodes.Description: Young-min finds his body in a critical condition and gets confused about if he is alive or dead; Young-min discovers that he can possess Seung-tak only; a mysterious man calls Young-min a coma ghost.

Episodes.Title: A Well-Planned Coincidence
Episodes.Description: Young-min suspects Seung-tak for the car accident but reconsiders his opinions when Seung-tak makes a sacrifice for him; a VIP patient suffers side effects after the surgery.

Episodes.Title: You Want In Or Out?
Episodes.Description: With an emergency patient in front of him, Seung-tak struggles. At the same time, Young-min faces the risk of disappearing for good. The two become physically and mentally inseparable, but neither one seems to accept the situation. Meanwhile, Young-min finds out who the wrongdoer behind Chairman Jang’s case is and gets shocked.

Episodes.Title: Help Me Out Here!
Episodes.Description: Seung-tak has no other option but to ask Young-min for help in saving an emergency patient. While Young-min is impressed with his good faith, he is also shocked and realizes that there is a possibility that Seung-tak might be seeing him. But first things first, the two team up to save the patient.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost Patient
Episodes.Description: Young-min finds out from the ghost patient that the accident he was involved in was also planned out by someone. Meanwhile, Seung-jo begs Seung-tak to do whatever it takes to save him. However, the only doctor who can save Seung-jo is Young-min, and the only person who can connect the two is Seung-tak.

Episodes.Title: What It Means to Save Someone’s Life
Episodes.Description: Young-min is excited that he can save someone’s life again. At the same time, Seung-tak asks Young-min what it’s like to save a life all on your own. Meanwhile, someone special to Young-min visits the hospital, not as a guest but as a patient.

Episodes.Title: Sharing Secrets
Episodes.Description: Young-min reveals the truth about what happened to Seung-tak 12 years ago; Young-min's assailant regains consciousness but cannot remember anything.

Episodes.Title: Ghost Doctor
Episodes.Description: Se-jin feels Young-min's presence when interacting with Seung-tak; Seung-won finds Seung-tak's behaviour suspicious.

Episodes.Title: No Reason to Hide
Episodes.Description: Young-min, still in Seung-tak's body, decides to reveal himself to Seung-won; Seung-tak helps Young-min spend some time with Se-jin; something unexpected happens at the hospital.

Episodes.Title: The Weak Spot
Episodes.Description: Young-min feels helpless when the coordination with Seung-jo goes wrong during surgery. Knowing how frustrated Young-min is, Seung-tak looks for other ways to save him. Meanwhile, Se-jin tries to keep a distance from Seung-tak, and Seung-tak is bothered by her sudden change in attitude. After pushing Seung-tak away, Se-jin is alone, and that’s when Min-ho barges in.

Episodes.Title: The Conflict
Episodes.Description: Se-jin collapses due to overwork and takes a few days off; Se-jin warns Seung-tak to stay away from Young-min; Seung-won and Tae-hyun hatch another plot.

Episodes.Title: Anything but This
Episodes.Description: Seung-tak loses control during his surgery and disappears, leaving everyone at the hospital worried. Young-min learns about Seung-tak's history, and Se-jin's suspicion about Seung-tak grows.

Episodes.Title: Thank You Tes
Episodes.Description: The connection between Young-min, Seung-tak, and Tes is revealed; Seung-tak returns to the hospital, and Se-jin is surprised to see the new Seung-tak.

Episodes.Title: A Difficult Decision
Episodes.Description: Se-jin discovers Seung-tak's secret; Seung-tak learns that the surgery has a major side effect; Young-min intends to treat as many patients; Young-min must make a tough choice.

Episodes.Title: Life and Death
Episodes.Description: Seung-tak and Young-min get ready for Young-min’s surgery, but Young-min looks like he has a lot on his mind. Either way, this is going to be their last surgery together as one. After the surgery, everyone waits to see if Young-min recovers. However, not everyone wishes that he would wake up or remember what has happened in the past few months.
